a: Lashon suresi lamma? o leshon hakkodesh, o lashon yevanit! veamar rabbi yose: [b]vavel – leshon arammi lamma? o leshon hakkodesh, o lashon parsi! amri: lashon yevani lechud, chochmat yevanit lechud.

Vechochmat yevanit mi asira?! vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel: "eni olla lenafshi mikkol benot iri" – elef yeladim hayu bevet abba; chamesh meot mehem lamdu tora, chamesh meot lamdu chochmat yevanit; velo nishtayyer mehem ella ani – kan, uven achi abba – beasya!

Amri: shane bet rabban gamliel, shehayu kerovim lammalchut. vechidtanya: hamesapper kome – hare ze middarche haemori. avtulemos bar reuven hittiru lo lesapper kome, mippene shehu karov lammalchut. shel bet rabban gamliel hittiru lahem lesapper bechochmat yevanit, mippene shekkerovim lammalchut.

Lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev ella im ken kashur beshalshelaot kulei. tanu rabbanan: lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev – ella im ken kashur beshalshelet. aval megaddel hu bair hassemucha lassefar, vekoshro bayyom umattiro ballayla.
Tanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: hamegaddel kelavim – kimgaddel chazirim. lemay nafka minna? lemekam aleh bearur.
Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: bavel – keir hassemucha lassefar dame. targema: nehardea.

Daresh rabbi dostay demin bere: "uvenucho yomar shuva Adonai rivvot alfe yisrael" – lelammedcha, sheen shechina shora al yisrael pachot mishshene alafim ushene revavot. chaser achat, vehayta ishsha meubberet benehem ureuya lehashelim, venavach bah kelev vehippila, nimtza ze gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael.
Hahi itteta deallat lemefa behahu beta, nevach ba kalba. amar la mareh: la tistefay minneh, shekili niveh. amara leh: shekila tevutaych veshadya achizre, kevar nad valad.
En porsin nishbin leyonim vechulei. umi azli kulle hay? vehatnan: marchikin et hashshovach min hair chamishshim amma! amar abbaye: meshat shayyti tuva, karsayyhu bachamishshim amma malya.
Umeshat sheloshim ris vetu la? vehatanya: bayyishshuv – afillu mea mil lo yifros! rav yosef amar: beyishshuv keramim. rabba amar: beyishshuv shovachin.
Vetippok leh mishshum shovachin gufayyhu! ibbaet ema: bidgoy, veibbaet ema: bidhefker, veibbaet ema: bedideh.
Hadaran alach merubba
b: Mishna hachovel bachavero, chayyayv alav mishshum chamishsha devarim: benezek, betzaar, berippuy, beshevet uvoshet.
Benezek ketzad? simme et eno; kata et yado; shibber et raglo – roin oto keillu hu eved nimkar bashshuk, veshamin kamma haya yafe vechamma hu yafe.
Tzaar – kevao (o) beshappud o bemasmer, vaafillu al tzipporno mekom sheeno ose chabbura – omdin kamma adam kayyotze baze rotze littol, lihyot mitztaer kach.

Rippuy – hikkahu, chayyayv lerappooto. ala bo tzemachim, im mechamat hammakka – chayyayv, shello mechamat hammakka – patur. chayyta venistera chayyta venistera – chayyayv lerappooto. chayyta kol tzorkah – eno chayyayv lerappooto.
Shevet – roin oto keillu hu shomer kishshuin, shekkevar natan lo deme yado udeme raglo.
Boshet – hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh.
Gemara ammay? "ayin tachat ayin" amar rachamana – ema ayin mammash!

La salka datach; detanya: yachol simme et eno – mesamme et eno, kata et yado – mekattea et yado, shibber et raglo – meshabber et raglo? talmud lomar: "makke adam" umakke vehema"; ma makke vehema – letashlumin, af makke adam – letashlumin.
Veim nafshecha lomar, hare hu omer: "lo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach, asher hu rasha lamut" – lenefesh rotzeach i atta lokeach kofer, aval atta lokeach kofer lerashe evarim sheen chozrin.
He "makke"? ilema "makke vehema yeshallemenna, umakke adam yumat" – hahu biktala ketiv!

Ella mehacha: "makke nefesh behema yeshallemenna, nefesh tachat nafesh", usemich leh: "veish ki yitten mum baamito, kaasher asa ken yease lo". hay lav "makke" hu! "hakkaa"–"hakkaa" kaamrinan; ma hakkaa haamura bivhema – letashlumin, af hakkaa haamura beadam – letashlumin.
Veha ketiv: "veish ki yakke kol nefesh adam, mot yumat"! bemamon. mimmay divmamon? ema bemita mammash!
La salka datach. chada – deha ittakkash lemakke vehema yeshallemenna". veod, ketiv batreh: "kaasher yitten mum baadam, ken yinnaten bo" – ushema minna mamon.
Umay "im nafshecha lomar"? tu ka kashya letanna – may chazet deyalfat mimmakke vehema? lelaf mimmakke adam!
Amri: danin neyzakin minneyzakin, veen danin neyzakin mimmita. adderabba! danin adam meadam, veen danin adam mibbehema!

Hayeynu dekatane "im nafshecha lomar" – hare hu omer: "lo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach asher hu rasha lamut, ki mot yumat" – lenefesh rotzeach i atta lokeach kofer, aval atta lokeach kofer lerashe evarim sheenan chozrin.

Vehay "lo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach" – lemaote rashe evarim hu daata? hay mibbee leh deamar rachamana la taaved beh tarte – la tishkol minneh mamon vetikteleh! hay mikkede rishato" nafka – risha achat atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo shete rishayot.

Veakkatti mibbee leh, dekaamar rachamana: la tishkol mamon vetiftereh! im ken, lichtov rachamana "lo tikkechu chofer laasher hu rasha lamut"; "lenefesh rotzeach" lema li? shema minna: lenefesh rotzeach i atta lokeach kofer, aval atta lokeach kofer lerashe evarim sheenan chozrin.

Vechi meachar dichtiv "lo tikkechu chofer", "makke"–"makke" lema li? amri: i mehay, hava amena: i bae – eno nittev, vei bae – deme eno nittev; ka mashma lan mibbehema, ma makke vehema – letashlumin, af makke adam – letashlumin.

Tanya, rabbi dostay ben yehuda omer: "ayin tachat ayin" – mamon. atta omer mamon, o eno ella ayin mammash? amarta, hare shehayta eno shel ze gedola veeno shel ze ketanna, heach ani kore beh "ayin tachat ayin"?
Vechi tema: kol ki hay – shakel minneh mamona; hattora amra: "mishpat echad yihye lachem" – mishpat hashshave lechullechem!
Amri: may kusheya? dilma nehora shekayl minneh, nehora amar rachamana nishkol minneh! dei la tema hachi,

a: Katan sheharag et haggadol vegadol sheharag et hakkatan, hechi katlinan leh? hattora amra: "mishpat echad yihye lachem" – mishpat hashshave lechullechem! ella neshama shekayl minneh, neshama amar rachamana nishkol minneh; hachi name, nehora shekayl minneh, nehora amar rachamana nishkol minneh!

Tanya iddach, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: "ayin tachat ayin" – mamon. atta omer mamon, o eno ella ayin mammash? hare shehaya some, vesimme; kittea, vekitta; chigger, vechigger; heach ani mekayyem baze "ayin tachat ayin" – vehattora amra: "mishpat echad yihye lachem", mishpat hashshave lechullechem?
Amri: umay kusheya? dilma hecha deefshar – efshar; hecha dela efshar – la efshar, ufatrinan leh! dei la tema hachi, terefa sheharag et hashshalem – may avdinan leh?
Ella hecha deefshar – efshar; hecha dela efshar – la efshar, ufatrinan leh!
Deve rabbi yishmael tana, amar kera: "ken yinnaten bo" – veen netina ella mamon. ella meatta, "kaasher yitten mum baadam" – hachi name demamon hu?

Amri: deve rabbi yishmael – kera yattira darshi; mikkede ketiv: "veish ki yitten mum baamito, kaasher asa ken yease lo"; "ken yinnaten bo" lema li? shema minna: mamon. "kaasher yitten mum baadam" – lema li? ayyeyde devae michtav "ken yinnaten bo", ketav name "kaasher yitten mum baadam".
Deve rabbi chiyyay tana, amar kera: "yad beyad" – davar hannittan miyyad leyad; umay nihu? mamon. ella meatta, "regel beragel" name hachi hu?!

Amri: deve rabbi chiyyay – kera yattira ka darshi; mikkede ketiv: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv"; i salka datach mammash, "yad beyad" lema li? shema minna: mamon. "regel beragel" lema li? ayyeyde dichtiv "yad beyad", ketav name "regel beragel".

Abbaye omer: atya middetane deve chizkiyya, detana deve chizkiyya: "ayin tachat ayin"; "nefesh tachat nafesh" – velo nefesh veayin tachat ayin. vei salka datach mammash, zimnin demashkachat la ayin vanefesh tachat ayin – devahade deavvayr leh, nefaka leh nishmeteh.

Umay kusheya? dilma memad amdinan leh; i matze mekabbel – avdinan, vei la matze mekabbel – la avdinan; vei amdinan dematze mekabbel, veavdinan beh unefak rucheh – i mayet, lemut! mi la tenan gabbe malkot: amaduhu, umet tachat yado – patur?
Rav zevid mishshemeh derabba amar, amar kera: "petza tachat patza" – litten tzaar bimkom nezek. vei salka datach mammash – ki hechi dilhay have leh tzaara, lehay name it leh tzaara!
Umay kusheya? dilma ikka inish dimfannak – it leh tzaara tefe, veikka inish dela mefannak – let leh tzaara! lemay nafka minna? lemittavoy leh hayech devene bene.
Rav pappa mishshemeh derava amar, amar kera: "verappo yerappe" – litten refua bimkom nezek. vei salka datach mammash – ki hechi dehay bae asyay, hay name bae asyay!
May kusheya? dilma ikka desalek bisreh hayyay, veikka dela salek bisreh hayyay! lemay nafka minna? lemittav leh hayech devene bene.
Rav ashe amar: atya "tachat"–"tachat" mishshor; ketiv hacha: "ayin tachat ayin", uchetiv hatam: "shallem yeshallem shor tachat hashshor" – ma lehallan mamon, af kan mamon.
May chazet deyalfat "tachat"–"tachat" mishshor? nelaf "tachat"–"tachat" meadam – dichtiv: "venatatta nefesh tachat nefesh"; ma lehallan mammash, af kan mammash!
Amri: danin nezakin minnezakin, veen danin nezakin mimmita. adderabba! danin adam meadam, veen danin adam mibbehema!
Ella amar rav ashe: mittachat asher innah" yalef leh – adam meadam, unezikin minnezikin.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: "ayin tachat ayin" – mammash. "mammash" salka datach?! rabbi eliezer let leh kechol hane tannae?!
Amar rabba: lomar sheen shamin oto keeved. amar leh abbaye: ella keman, keven chorin?! ben chorin mi it leh dame? ella amar rav ashe: lomar sheen shamin oto benizzak, ella bemazzik.

Hahu chamra dekatta yeda deyanoka. ata lekammeh derav pappa bar shemuel, amar lehu: zilu shumu leh arbaa devarim. amar leh rava: veha anan chamishsha tenan! amar leh: levar minnezek kaamena. amar leh abbaye: veha chamor hu, vachamor eno meshallem ella nezek! amar lehu: zilu shumu leh nizkeh. veha keavda bae lemishyeymeh! amar lehu: zilu shayymuhv keavda.
Amar lehu avu deyanoka: la baena, dezila beh milleta. amaru leh: veha ka mechayyeyvat leh leyanoka! amar lehu: lechi gadel, mefayyesna leh middidi.

Hahu tora daalas yedeh deyanoka. ata lekammeh derava, amar lehu: zilu shayymuhv keavda. amaru leh: veha mar hu deamar: kol hannishshom keeved – en govin oto bevavel! amar lehu: la tzericha, dei tefas.
Rava letameh, deamar rava: nizke shor beshor, venizke shor beadam – govin oto bevavel. nizke adam beadam, venizke adam beshor – en govin oto bevavel.
May shena nizke adam beadam venizke adam beshor, dela – "elohim" baenan, velekka; nizke shor beshor veshor beadam name –
b: "Elohim" baenan, velekka!
Ella may shena shor beshor veshor beadam? dishlichutayyhu ka avdinan – midde dehave ahodaot vehalevaot. adam beadam veadam beshor name, shelichutayyhu ka avdinan – midde dehave ahodaot vehalevaot!
Amri: ki ka avdinan shelichutayyhu – bemidde dekim lan begavveh; bemidde dela kim lan begavveh – la avdinan shelichutayyhu.
Amri: shor beshor veshor beadam name la kim lan begavveh – ella pok chazi (hecha) [kamma] mizdabbeni tore beshuka; adam beadam veadam beshor name, pok chazi (hecha) [kamma] mizdabbeni avde beshuka!
Veod, tashlum kefel vetashlum arbaa vachamishsha, dekitzi, naaved shelichutayyhu!
Amri: ki ka avdinan shelichutayyhu – bemamona, biknasa – la avdinan shelichutayyhu.
Adam beadam, demamona hu, naaved shelichutayyhu! ki ka avdinan shelichutayyhu bemilleta dishchicha, adam beadam dela shechicha – la avdinan shelichutayyhu.

Hare boshet ufegam, dishchiach, naaved shelichutayyhu! amri: hachi name; deha rav pappa agbi arba mea zuze levoshet. veha leteh lidrav pappa! dishlach leh rav chisda lerav nachman, ushelach leh: chisda chisda, kenasa ka magbet bevavel?!

Ella ki avdinan shelichutayyhu – bemilleta dishchicha, veit beh chesron kis; aval milleta dishchicha velet beh chesron kis, i name milleta dela shechicha veit beh chesron kis – la avdinan shelichutayyhu. hilkach, adam beadam – af al gav deit beh chesron kis, kevan dela shechicha – la avdinan shelichutayyhu; boshet – af al gav dishchicha, kevan delet beh chesron kis – la avdinan shelichutayyhu.

Veshor beshor govin bevavel? vehaamar rava: shor shehizzik – en govin oto bevavel. deazzek man? ilema deazzek adam, may irya shor deazzek adam? afillu adam deazzek adam name en govin oto bevavel! ella peshita – deazzek shor, vekatane: en govin oto bevavel!
Amri: hatam betam, hacha bemuad. vehaamar rava: en muad bevavel! amri: deiyyayad hatam veayyeytu lehacha.

Veha milleta dela shechicha hi, umilleta dela shechicha ha amrat dela avdinan shelichutayyhu! daato rabbanan dehatam, veyayadu hacha. sof sof, milleta dela shechicha hi, veat amrat milleta dela shechicha la (ka) avdinan shelichutayyhu!
Ella ki kaamar rava – beshen varegel, demuadin mittechillatan ninhu.

Tzaar – kevoo beshappud o bemasmer vechulei. tzaar shello bimkom nezek mishtallem – man tanna? amar rava: ben azzay hi – detanya, rabbi omer: "keviyya" neemra techilla. ben azzay omer: "chabbura" neemra techilla.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rabbi savar: "keviyya" – delet ba chabbura mashma; ketav rachamana "chabbura" legalloye ala dichviyya – deit ba chabbura in, i la la.
Uven azzay savar: "keviyya" – deit ba chabbura mashma; ketav rachamana "chabbura" legalloye ala dichviyya – delet ba chabbura.

Matkef la rav pappa: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera! rabbi omer "keviyya" neemra techilla – savar: "keviyya" – deit ba chabbura mashma; ketav rachamana "chabbura" legalloye ala dichviyya – delet ba chabbura.
Ben azzay omer "chabbura" neemra techilla – savar: "keviyya" – delet ba chabbura mashma; ketav rachamana "chabbura" legalloye ala dichviyya – deit ba chabbura in, i la la. veammassekana kayymi.
I name, dechulle alma: "keviyya" – ben deit bah chabbura ben delet ba chabbura mashma; vehacha

a: Bichlal uferat hameruchakim ze mizze kamippalgi –
Rabbi savar: en danin oto bichlal uferat, uven azzay savar: danin oto bichlal uferat. vechi tema "chabbura" lerabbi lema li? ledamim yeterim.
Omdin kamma adam kayyotze baze rotze littol vechulei. tzaar bimkom nezek, hechi shayyminan?

Amar avu dishmuel: omdin kamma adam rotze littol liktoa lo yado. liktoa lo yado?! la tzaar lechodeh hu – ha kullehu chamishsha devarim ikka! veod, beshufetane askinan?! ella liktoa yado hakketua. yado hakketua name la tzaar lechodeh ikka, ha tzaar uvoshet ikka – dichsifa leh milleta lemishkal mibbesaro lemishdeyeh lichlavim!
Ella omdin kamma adam rotze littol liktoa lo yado hammuchetevet lammalchut, ben sam lesayif. amri: hacha name la shakel umetzaar nafsheh!
Ella omdin kamma adam rotze litten liktoa lo yado hammuchetevet lammalchut, ben sayif lesam.
Hay "littol"?! "litten" mibbee leh! amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: littol ze mizze, ma shennatan ze.

Rippuy – hikkahu, chayyayv lerappooto vechulei. [tanu rabbanan:] alu bo tzemachim mechamat hammakka, venistera hammakka – chayyayv lerappooto, vechayyayv litten lo deme shivto. shello mechamat hammakka – eno chayyayv lerappooto, veeno chayyayv litten lo deme shivto.

Rabbi yehuda omer: af mechamat hammakka – chayyayv lerappooto, veeno chayyayv litten lo deme shivto. vachachamim omrim: shivto – urefuato; kol shechayyayv beshevet – chayyayv berippuy, vesheeno chayyayv beshevet – eno chayyayv berippuy.
Bemay ka mippalgi? amar rabba: ashkachtinhu lerabbanan beve rav deyatvi vekaamri: hacha bemakka nittena leeged kamippalgi –
Rabbanan savri: makka nittena leeged. verabbi yehuda savar: makka lo nittena leeged; rippuy, ditna beh kera – michayyayv; shevet, dela tena beh kera – la michayyayv.
Veamena lehu ana: i makka lo nittena leeged, rippuy name la michayyayv! ella dechulle alma – makka nittena leeged, velo nittena leeged yetera.

Rabbi yehuda savar: kevan delo nittena leeged yetera, rippuy ditna beh kera – michayyayv, shevet dela tena beh kera – la michayyayv. verabbanan savri: kevan ditna beh kera berippuy – ashshevet name michayyayv, deittakkash lerippuy.
Verabbi yehuda savar: shevet la michayyayv, demaateh rachamana "rak". verabbanan – "rak", leshello mechamat hammakka hu daata.

Ulerabbanan batrae, deamri: kol shechayyayv beshevet – chayyayv berippuy, vechol sheeno chayyayv beshevet – eno chayyayv berippuy; rippuy ditna beh kara – lema li? mibbee leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael – detanya, deve rabbi yishmael omer: "verappo yerappe" – mikkan shennittan reshut larofe lerappoot.

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheim alu bo tzemachim mechamat hammakka venistera hammakka, shechayyayv lerappooto, vechayyayv litten lo shivto? talmud lomar: "rak shivto yitten, verappo yerappe". yachol afillu shello mechamat hammakka? talmud lomar: "rak". rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: af mechamat hammakka patur, shenneemar: "rak".
Ikka deamri "af mechamat hammakka patur" – ligmare, kerabbanan batrae; veikka deamri "af mechamat hammakka patur" – mishshevet, vechayyayv berippuy; keman? kaavu.
Amar mar: yachol afillu shello mechamat hammakka? talmud lomar: "rak". shello mechamat hammakka bae kera?!

Amri: may "shello mechamat hammakka" – kidtanya: hare sheavar al divre rofe veachal devash o kol mine metika, mippene sheddevash vechol mine metika kashin lammakka; veheela makkato garguteni; yachol yehe chayyayv lerappooto? talmud lomar: "rak". may "garguteni"? amar abbaye: nata kerichta. may asuteh? ahala vekira vekalba.
Vei amar leh: "asyaych ana", amar leh: "damet alay kearya arva". vei amar leh: "mayytina asya demaggan (bemaggan)", amar leh: "asya demaggan (bemaggan) – maggan shave".
Vei amar: "mayytina lach asya rachika", amar leh: "asya rachika – ena avayr".

Vei amar leh hayech: "hav li ledidi, vaana massena nafshay", amar leh: "pashat benafshach veshaklat minnay tefe". vei amar leh: "kutz li mikkatz", amar leh: "kol shekken defashat benafshach, vekaru li: "shor hammazzik".
Tana: vechullan mishtallemin bimkom nezek. menahane mille? amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava, amar kera: "petza tachat patza" – litten tzaar bimkom nezek.
Hay mibbee leh
b: Lerabbot shogeg kemezid veones keratzon! im ken, nichtov kera: "petza befatza"; may "petza tachat patza"? shema minna tarte.
Rav pappa mishshemeh derava amar, amar kera: "verappo yerappe" – litten refua bimkom nezek.

Hay mibbee leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "verappo yerappe" – mikkan shennittena reshut larofe lerappoot! im ken, nichtov kera "verofe yerappe"! shema minna, litten refua bimkom nezek.
Veakkatti mibbee leh lichdaamaran, lemitne beh kera berippuy! im ken, lema kera o "rappo rappo" o "yerappe yerappe", may "verappo yerappe"? shema minna litten refua bimkom nezek.
Michlal demashkachat lehu shello bimkom nezek. shello bimkom nezek hechi mashkachat lehu?

Tzaar – kidkatane: tzaar – kevoo beshappud o bemasmer, vaafillu al tzipporno mekom sheeno ose chabbura. rippuy – dahava kaev leh midde, uselek veayyti leh samma charifa, veachvevreh levisreh; ditzrich leotove leh samma leankoteh gavvna devisreh.
Shevet – dehaddekeh beinderona, uvatteleh. boshet – derak leh beappeh.

Shevet – roin oto keillu hu shomer kishshuin. tanu rabbanan: shevet – roin oto keillu hu shomer kishshuin. veim tomar: lakta middat haddin; dechi mittefach hay gavra, lav agra deshomer kishshuin hu shakel, ella dale davvla veshakel agra; i name azel bishlich[uta] veshakel agra!
Middat haddin lo lakta, shekkevar natan lo deme yado udeme raglo.
Amar rava: kitta et yado – noten lo deme yado, veshevet – roin oto keillu hu shomer kishshuin. shibber et raglo – noten lo deme raglo, veshevet – roin oto keillu hu shomer et happetach.
Simme et eno – noten lo deme eno, veshevet – roin oto keillu hu matchino berechayim. chersho – noten lo deme chullo.

Bae rava: kitta et yado velo amaduhu, shibber et raglo velo amaduhu, simme et eno velo amaduhu – ulevassof chersho, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan dela amaduhu – bechad umedana saggi leh, veyahev leh deme chulleh bahade hadade? o dilma, chada chada amdinan veyahavinan leh –

Nafka minneh devae lemittav leh tzaar uvoshet dechol chada vachada; nehi denezek verippuy veshevet dechol chada vachada la yahavinan leh – dechevan deka yahev leh deme chulleh, keman dekatleh dame, veha yehayv leh deme chulleh; tzaar uvoshet mihat dechol chada vachada yahev, deha hava leh tzaar uvoshet?

Veim timtze lomar: kevan delo amaduhu, ka yahev leh deme kulleh bahade hadade; amaduhu, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan daamaduhu – chada chada bae lemittav leh; o dilma, kevan dela shallem – yahev leh deme chulleh? teku.

Bae rabba: shevet happochatto bedamim, mahu? hechi dame? kegon shehikkahu al yado vetzamta yado, vesofah lachazor; may? kevan desofah lachazor – la yahev leh vela midde; o dilma, hasheta mihat afchateh?
Ta shema: hammakke aviv veimmo velo asa bahen chabbura, vehachovel bachavero beyom hakkippurim –

a: Chayyayv bechullan.
Hay "lo asa bo chabbura", hechi dame? lav kegon shehikkahu al yado vesofo lachzor? vekatane: chayyayv bechullan!

Amri: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shechersho, velo asa bo chabbura. vehaamar rabba: (hachoresh) [cheresh] et aviv – neherag, lefi shei efshar lacharisha belo chabbura; tippeta didma nefala leh beudeneh!
Ella hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheggillecho. gillecho – mihdar hadar, vehayeynu bayayn!
Amri: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shessacho nasha, dela hadar.

Tzaar – deit leh kartufane beresheh, vetzavavchoy [leh] mehanhu kartufane. rippuy – devae assoye. shevet – dahava merakked be chubbe, devae machve gavne aresheh; vela machve – mehanhu kartufane. boshet – en lecha boshet gadol mizze.

Umilleta devaya leh lerabba – peshita leh leabbaye lehach gisa, ulerava lehach gisa. deittemar: hikkahu al yado vetzamta, vesofah lachazor – abbaye amar: noten lo shevet gedola veshevet ketanna. verava amar: eno noten lo ella deme shivto shebbechol yom vayom.
Ittemar: hakkotea yad eved ivri shel chavero – abbaye amar: noten lo shevet gedola laeved, veshevet ketanna larav. rava amar: hakkol yinnaten laeved, veyillakach bahen karka veharav ochel perot.
Peshita – pichet etzel atzmo, veetzel rabbo lo pichet – hechi dame? defaskeh leresh unne o leresh nechireh – hakkol leatzmo. pichet etzel rabbo – pelugeta deabbaye verava.
Boshet – hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. manni matnitin? la rabbi meir vela rabbi yehuda, ella rabbi shimon hi.

Ditnan: vechullan – roin otan keillu hem bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem, shehen bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov; divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: haggadol lefi godlo, vehakkatan lefi kotno. rabbi shimon omer: ashirim – roin otan keillu hem bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem, aniyyim – kifchutin shebbahen.

Manni? hasheta i rabbi meir – matnitin katane: hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh; verabbi meir – kullehu bahade hadade ninhu! vei rabbi yehuda – matnitin katane: hamevayyesh et hassome – chayyayv; veillu rabbi yehuda omer: some en lo boshet! ella lav rabbi shimon hi?
Afillu tema rabbi yehuda, ki amar rabbi yehuda some en lo boshet – lemishkal minneh, aval lemitteva leh – yahavinan leh.

Veha middekatane sefa: hamevayyesh et hayyashen – chayyayv, veyashen shebbiyyesh – patur; vela katane: some shebbiyyesh – patur; mikkelal dela shena hachi vela shena hachi! ella mechavvavrta matnitin rabbi shimon hi.

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: nitkavvevn levayyesh et hakkatan, uviyyesh et haggadol – noten laggadol deme voshto shel katan. levayyesh et haeved, uviyyesh et ben chorin – noten leven chorin deme voshto shel eved. manni? la rabbi meir, vela rabbi yehuda, vela rabbi shimon!

Ka salka datach: katan – katan binchasim, gadol – gadol binchasim. i rabbi meir, haamar: kullehu bahade hadade ninhu! vei rabbi yehuda, haamar: en laavadim boshet! vei rabbi shimon, haamar: nitkavvevn levayyesh et ze, uviyyesh et ze – patur!

May tama? kiktala; ma ketala – ad demitkavvevn leh, dichtiv: "vearav lo vekam alav" – ad sheyyitkavvevn lo; boshet name – ad demikkavven leh, dichtiv: "veshalcha yadah vehechezika bimvushav" – ad sheyyitkavvevn lo!
Leolam rabbi yehuda, vechi kaamar rabbi yehuda: en laavadim boshet – lemitteva lehu; aval lemesham – shayyminan behu.
Vei baet ema: afillu tema rabbi meir, mi savrat: gadol – gadol binchasim, katan – katan binchasim? lo; gadol – gadol mammash, vekatan – katan mammash.
Vekatan bar boshet hu?! in; kidamar rav pappa: demaychlemu leh umikkelam; hacha name –
b: Demaychlemu leh umikkelam.

Mishna hamevayyesh et hearom, hamevayyesh et hassome, vehamevayyesh et hayyashen – chayyayv. veyashen shebbiyyesh – patur. nafal min haggag, vehizzik uviyyesh – chayyayv al hannezek, ufatur al habboshet ad sheyyehe mitkavven.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: biyyeysho arom – chayyayv, veeno dome biyyeysho arom leviyyeysho lavush. biyyeysho bevet hammerchatz – chayyayv, veeno dome biyyeysho bevet hammerchatz leviyyeysho bashshuk.
Amar mar: biyyeysho arom – chayyayv. arom bar boshet hu?! amar rav pappa: may "arom" – daata zika karchinhu lemaneh, vaata hu dallinhu tefe uvayyeysheh.
Biyyeysho bevet hammerchatz – chayyayv. bet hammerchatz bar boshet hu?! amar rav pappa: shebbiyyeysho al gav hannahar.

Bae rabbi abba bar memel: biyyeysho yashen – vamet, mahu? may kamibbaya leh? amar rav zevid, hachi kamibbaya leh: mishshum kissufa hu – veha mit leh velet leh kissufa, o dilma mishshum ziluta hu – veha ozleh?
Ta shema, rabbi meir omer: cheresh vekatan – yesh lahen boshet, shote – en lo boshet. i amrat bishlama mishshum ziluta, hayeynu dekatane katan; ella i amrat mishshum kissufa, katan bar boshet hu?!
Ella may, mishshum ziluta? afillu shote name! amri: shote – en lecha boshet gedola mizzo.
Mikkol makom nifshot minna demishshum ziluta hu, dei mishshum kissufa – katan bar kissufa hu? kidamar rav pappa: demaychlemu leh umikkelam, hacha name – demaychlemu leh umikkelam.
Rav pappa amar, hachi kamibbaya leh: mishshum kissufa dideh hu – vehu miyt leh, o dilma mishshum boshet mishpacha?
Ta shema: cheresh vekatan yesh lo boshet, shote en lo boshet. i amrat bishlama mishshum boshet mishpacha – hayeynu dekatane katan. ella i amrat mishshum kissufa dideh – katan bar boshet hu?
Ella may? mishshum boshet divne mishpacha? afillu shote name! shote – en lecha boshet gedola mizzo.
Mikkol makom nifshot minna demishshum boshet mishpacha, dei mishshum kissufa – katan bar kissufa hu? amar rav pappa: in, demaychlemu leh umikkelam.
Vehatanya, rabbi omer: cheresh – yesh lo boshet. shote – en lo boshet. katan – peamim yesh lo, peamim en lo – ha demaychlemu leh umikkelam, ha demaychlemu leh vela mikkelam.

Hamevayyesh et hassome vechulei. matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda; detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: some – en lo boshet, vechach haya rabbi yehuda poter mechayyayve galiyyot, umechayyayve malkiyyot, umechayyayve mitot bet din.
May tama derabbi yehuda? gamar "enecha"–"enecha" meedim zommin; ma hatam somin la, af hacha somin la.
Mechayyayve galiyyot – detanya: "belo reot" – perat lassome, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: lerabbot et hassome.
May tama derabbi yehuda? amar lach: "vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar lachtov etzim" – vaafillu some; ketav rachamana "belo reot" – lemaote.
Verabbi meir – ketav rachamana "belo reot" lemaote, uchetav rachamana "bivli daat" lemaote; have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot.
Verabbi yehuda – hahu "bivli daat", perat lemitkavven hu daata.
Chayyayve mitot bet din – atya "rotzeach"–"rotzeach" mechayyayve galiyyot.
Chayyayve malkiyyot – atya "rasha"–"rasha" mechayyayve mitot bet din.
Tanya iddach, rabbi yehuda omer: some en lo boshet.

a: Vechen haya rabbi yehuda potro mikkol dinim shebbattora. may tama derabbi yehuda? amar kera: "veshaftu haeda ben hammakke uven goel haddam al hammishpatim haelle" – kol sheyyeshno bemakke uvegoel haddam, yeshno bemishpatim; kol sheeno bemakke uvaggoel haddam, eno bemishpatim.

Tanya iddach, rabbi yehuda omer: some en lo boshet. vechen haya rabbi yehuda potro mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora. amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: may tama derabbi yehuda? amar kera: "veelle hammitzvot hachukkim vehammishpatim" – kol sheyyeshno bemishpatim, yeshno bemitzvot vechukkim; vechol sheeno bemishpatim, eno bemitzvot vechukkim.
Amar rav yosef, meresh hava amena: man deamar halacha kerabbi yehuda – deamar: some patur min hammitzvot, ka avedyna yoma tava lerabbanan, may tama? dela mippakkadna, veka avedyna mitzvot.

Vehasheta dishmait leha derabbi chanina, deamar rabbi chanina: gadol hametzuvvev veose – mimmi sheeno metzuvvev veose; man deamar li: en halacha kerabbi yehuda, avedna yoma tava lerabbanan. may tama? dechi mippakkadyna – it li agra tefe.
Mishna ze chomer baadam mibbashshor – shehaadam meshallem nezek, tzaar, rippuy, shevet uvoshet, umeshallem deme veladot; veshor eno meshallem ella nezek, ufatur middeme veladot.
Hammakke et aviv veet immo velo asa bahen chabbura, vechovel bachavero beyom hakkippurim – chayyayv bechullan.
Hachovel beeved ivri – chayyayv bechullan, chutz min hashshevet bizman shehu shello. hachovel beeved kenaani shel acherim – chayyayv bechullan. rabbi yehuda omer: en laavadim boshet.
Cheresh, shote vekatan pegiatan raa, hachovel bahen – chayyayv, vehem shechavlu baacherim – peturin.
Haeved vehaishsha pegiatan raa, hachovel bahem – chayyayv, vehem shechavlu baacherim – peturin, aval meshallemin leachar zeman. nitgarsha haishsha, nishtachrer haeved – chayyayvin leshallem.
Hammakke aviv veimmo veasa bahen chabbura, vehachovel bachavero beshabbat – patur mikkullan, mippene shehu niddon benafsho.
Vehachovel beeved kenaani shello – patur mikkullan.
Gemara bea minneh rabbi elazar merav: hachovel bevat ketanna shel acherim, chavala lemi?

Mi amrinan: kevan deakni leh rachamana shevach neurim leav – chavala name daavu have, may tama – deha afchata mikkaspa; o dilma, shevach neurim hu deakni leh rachamana, dei bae lemimsar la lemukke shechin – matze masar, aval chavala – kevan dei bae mi(400)chebal ba la matze chavel, la (kanyeh) [akni] leh rachamana?
b: Amar leh: lo zikketa tora laav, ella shevach neurim bilvad. etiveh: hachovel beeved ivri – chayyayv bechullan, chutz min hashshevet bizman shehu shello! amar abbaye: mode rav beshevet, demaase yadeha ad sheat bagrut – daavu have.

Etiveh: hachovel bivno gadol – yitten lo miyyad, bivno katan – yaase lo segulla. hachovel bevitto ketanna – patur, velo od, ella acherim shechavlu bah – chayyayvin litten leaviha! hachi name beshevet.
Uvivno gadol yitten lo miyyad? ureminhu: hachovel bevanav uvivnotav shel acherim, gedolim – yitten lahem miyyad, ketannim – yaase lahem segulla. bevanav uvivnotav shello – patur!
Amri: la kashya; kan keshessemuchim al shulchano, kan kesheen semuchin al shulchano.

Bemay okemta lekammayyta – besheen semuchin al shulchano? i hachi, ema sefa: hachovel bevitto hakketanna – patur; velo od, ella acherim shechavlu bah – chayyayvin litten leaviha. ledida bae lemittav la – devaya mezone!

Vaafillu leman deamar: yachol harav lomar laeved "ase immi veeni zanach"; hane mille beeved kenaani – deamar leh: aved avidta kulle yoma, uleureta zil sechar veechol; aval eved ivri, dichtiv: "ki tov lo immach" – immecha bemaachol, immecha bemishte – lo kol shekken bitto?!
Kidamar rava bereh derav ulla: lo nitzrecha ella lehaedafa; hacha name, la nitzrecha ella lehaedafa.
Bemay okemta levatrayyta – bismuchin al shulchano? "gedolim – yitten lahem miyyad, ketannim – yaase lahem segulla", ammay? laavihem bae lemittav!
Amri: ki ka kafed – bemidde deka chasar, bemidde daata mealma – la kafed.

Veha metzia, demealma kaate lehu, veka kafed! amri: ravvcha dekaate lehu mealma, velet lehu tzaara degufayyhu begavvav – kafed; aval chavala, deit lehu tzaara degufayyhu, umealma kaate lehu – la kafed.
Veha hatam, deit la tzaara degufa, umealma kaate la, veka kafed! dekatane: velo od, ella (afillu) acherim shechavlu bah – chayyayvin litten leaviha!

Amri: hatam, degavra kafdana hu, deha en semuchin al shulchano – afillu bemidde deate lehu mealma kafed. hacha, delav gavra kafdana hu, deha semuchin al shulchano; ki ka kafed – bemidde deka chasar leh, bemidde deate lehu mealma – la kafed.
May "segulla"? rav chisda amar: sefer tora. rabba bar rav huna amar: dikla deachel minneh tamre.
Vechen amar resh lakish: lo zikketa tora laav – ella shevach neurim bilvad. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu petzia.
Petzia salka datach?! afillu rabbi elazar la kamibbaya leh ella chavala –

a: Deafchata mikkaspa; aval petzia – dela afchata mikkaspa, la kamibbaya leh!
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: sheppetzaah befaneha, veafchata mikkaspa.

Hachovel beeved kenaani shel acherim – chayyayv vechulei. may tama derabbi yehuda? amar kera: "ki yinnatzu anashim yachdav ish veachiv" – bemi sheyyesh lo achva, yatza eved sheen lo achva. verabbanan – achiv hu bemitzvot.
Ella meatta, lerabbi yehuda – zomme eved lo yehargu, dichtiv: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv"! amar rava amar rav sheshet, amar kera: "uviarta hara mikkirbecha" – mikkol makom.
Ella meatta, lerabbanan – eved yehe kasher lammalchut! amri: uletamaych, tikshe lach ger – ledivre hakkol! ella amar kera: "mikkerev achecha" – mimmuvechar shebbeachecha.
Ella meatta, lerabbanan – yehe eved kasher leedut, dichtiv: "vehinne ed sheker haed, sheker ana veachiv"!
Amar ulla: edut la matzet amrat; atya edut bekal vachomer meishsha: uma ishsha, shehi reuya lavo bakkahal – pesula leedut; eved, sheeno rauy lavo bakkahal – eno din sheppasul leedut?
Ma leishsha – shekken enah reuya lemila; tomar beeved shehu rauy lemila?! katan yochiach – sheyyeshno bemila, ufasul leedut.
Ma lekatan – sheeno bemitzvot; tomar beeved, shehu bemitzvot?! ishsha tochiach – sheyyeshnah bemitzvot, ufesula leedut.

Vechazar haddin: lo rei ze chiri ze, velo rei ze chiri ze; hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken enan bechol hammitzvot, ufesulin lehaid; af ani avi et haeved – sheeno bechol hammitzvot, ufasul lehaid.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahem – shekken eno ish; tomar beeved, shehu ish?!
Ella tete miggazlan. ma legazlan – shekken maasav garmu lo; tomar beeved – sheen maasav garmu lo?!
Ella tete miggazlan umechad mehanach.

Mar bereh deravina amar, amar kera: "lo yumetu avot al banim" – lo yumetu al pi avot sheen lahem chayis banim. dei salka datach kidamrinan: "lo yumetu avot al banim" – beedut banim; lichtov rachamana: "lo yumetu avot al benehem"! may "banim"? shema minna delo yumetu al pi avot sheen lahem chayis banim.
Ella meatta, "uvanim lo yumetu al avot" – hachi name, lo yumetu al pi banim sheen lahem chayis avot? ella ger hachi name defasul leedut?!
Amri: hachi hasheta?! ger, nehi deen lo chayis lemala, lematta yesh lo chayis; leappoke eved, deen lo chayis lo lemala velo lematta.

Dei salka datach ger pasul leedut, lichtov rachamana: "lo yumetu avot al benehem" lechidamrinan – lo yumetu beedut banim; venichtov rachamana: "uvanim lo yumetu al avot" – deshamat minna tere: chada – lo yumetu banim beedut avot, veiddach – lo yumetu al pi banim sheen lahem chayis avot!
Veeved – nafka leh bekal vachomer migger; uma ger, dilmala hu deen lo chayis, aval lematta yesh lo chayis – pasul leedut; eved, sheen lo chayis lo lemala velo lematta – eno din sheyyehe pasul leedut?

Ella middichtav rachamana: "lo yumetu avot al banim" – demashma: lo yumetu al pi avot sheen lo chayis banim; shema minna, eved, sheen lo chayis lo lemala velo lematta – hu defasul leedut; aval ger, kevan deyesh lo chayis lematta – kasher leedut.

Vechi tema, lichtov rachamana: "uvanim lo yumetu al avotehem", lema li dichtav rachamana: "uvanim lo yumetu al avot" – demashma: lo yumetu al pi banim sheen lahem chayis avot? ayyeyde dichtav: "la yumetu avot al banim", ketav name: "uvanim lo yumetu al avot".
Cheresh, shote vekatan pegiatan raa. immeh derav shemuel bar abba mehageronya havat nesiva leh lerabbi abba, ketavtinhu (lenichse) [lenichsa] lerav shemuel bar abba bera. batar dishchiva,
b: Azal rav shemuel bar abba kammeh derabbi yirmeya bar abba, okmeh benichse. azal rabbi abba amra lemilleta kammeh derav hoshaya, azal rav hoshaya amra kammeh derav yehuda. amar leh, hachi amar shemuel: haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah, vameta – habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot.

Amruha kammeh derabbi yirmeya bar abba, amar lehu: ana matnita yadana, ditnan: hakkotev nechasav livno leachar moto – habben eno yachol limkor, mippene shehen birshut haav; vehaav eno yachol limkor, mippene shehen ketuvin labben. machar haav – mechurim ad sheyyamut. machar habben – en lo lallokeach ad sheyyamut haav.
Ki mayet av miha it leh lelokeach, veaf al gav demet habben bechayye av – dela ato lide habben.
Kerabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar: la shena met habben bechayye haav – dela ato lideh deven, la shena met haav bechayye habben – daato lideh deven; kana lokeach.
Deittemar: machar habben bechayye haav, umet habben bechayye haav – rabbi yochanan amar: lo kana lokeach, resh lakish amar: kana lokeach.

Rabbi yochanan amar lo kana lokeach – amar lach: ki katane matnitin "machar habben – lo kana lokeach ad sheyyamut haav", vechi mayet haav it leh lelokeach – delo met habben bechayye haav, daato lide habben. aval met habben bechayye haav, dela ato lideh deven – ki mayet av name let leh lelokeach.
Alma ka savar: kinyan perot – kekinyan hagguf dame, vechi zabben – lav dideh zabben.

Rabbi shimon ben lakish omer kana lokeach – ki katane matnitin: "machar habben en lallokeach ad sheyyamut haav" – ki mayet av mihat it leh lelokeach; la shena la met habben bechayye haav – daato lideh deven, vela shena met habben bechayye haav – dela ato lideh deven; kana lokeach.
Alma kasavar: kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame, vechi (ka) zabben – dideh (ka) zabben.

Vaanan hasheta, ben rabbi yirmeya bar abba uven rav yehuda – kerabbi shimon ben lakish sevira lehu. vekaamar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: i salka datach kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame, ki mayet av umayet habben bechayye haav, ammay it leh lelokeach? ki (ka) zabben hay – lav dideh (ka) zabben!
Ella lav shema minna kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame?
Ahderuha lekammeh derav yehuda, amar lehu, hachi amar shemuel: zo enah doma lemishnatenu.
May tama? amar rav yosef, bishlama i tane ippecha: "hakkotev nechasav leaviv" – ikka lemifshat minna dekinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame.
Ella hasheta dekatane: "hakkotev nechasav livno", mishshum derauy leyorsho hu.
Amar leh abbaye: attu bera yaret abba, abba la yaret bera?! ella leavrochinhu lenichse mibbereh ka ate; hacha name, leavrochinhu lenichse meachu ate.
Ella may "enah doma lemishnatenu"? mishshum takkanat usha. deamar rabbi yose bar chanina: beusha hitkinu, haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah, umeta – habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot.
Amar rav idi bar avin, af anan name tenena: "meidim anu beish peloni sheggerash et ishto, venatan ketubbatah",

a: Vahare hi tachtav umeshammashto; venimtzeu zommin; en omrim yeshallemu kol ketubbatah, ella tovat hanaat ketubbatah. ezehu tovat hanaat ketubbatah? omdin kamma adam rotze litten bichtubba shel zo – sheim nitarmela o nitgarsha, veim meta – yirashenna baalah.
Vei salka datach leta letakkanat usha, ammay yirashenna baalah? tezabben ketubbeta ligmare!
Amar abbaye: im amru benichse melog, yomru benichse tzon barzel?!

Amar abbaye: tovat hanaa, hoil vaata leyadan, nema ba milleta: tovat hanaa – leishsha havya. dei salka datach levaal havya, lemru la edim: may afsedynnich? i hava mezabbenat la letovat hanaa, baal hava shakel minnich! amar rav shalman: mishshum deikka revavch beta.
Amar rava, hilcheta: tovat hanaa laishsha, veen habbaal ochel perot. may tama? pera takkinu leh rabbanan, pera defera la takkinu leh rabbanan.

Ki ata rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua mibbe rav, amri, tenena letakkanat usha: haeved vehaishsha pegiatan raa; hachovel bahen chayyayv, vehem shechavlu baacherim – peturin. vei salka datach leta letakkanat usha, tezabben nichse melog vetitten leh!
Uletamaych, nehi name deitay letakkanat usha – vela matze mezabbena ligmare; tezabben lenichse melog betovat hanaa, vetitten leh! ella delet la; hachi name delet la.
Utezabben ketubbeta betovat hanaa, vetitten leh! ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: asur lo leadam sheyyeshahe et ishto afillu shaa achat belo ketubba.
Vetama may – kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah; hacha la megaresh la – dei megaresh la, atu hanach dezavni, gavu la lichtubbeta minneh!
Ella tovat hanaa mille ninhu, umille la mishtabedi.
Allema la? mille demizdabbeni bedinare ninhu! ella mishshum dishmuel, deamar shemuel: hammocher shetar chov lachavero, vechazar umechalo – machul. vaafillu yoresh mochel.
Amri: zabbone [t]zabben vetitten leh, vei machala leh legabbe vaal – timchala.
Amri: kol legabbe vaal, vadday machala leh. (veafsedinneh lehahu zevina beyadayim la afsedinhu.)
Vechi tema: (zevina) [tezabbenay] nihaleh lehahu dachavala beh betovat hanaa,
b: Dei machala legabbe vaal – la ka mafsed, dehashta name la midde ka yahava leh! sof sof, kol legabbe vaal – vadday machala, veatroche be dina bichdi la matrechinan.
Ella ha detanya: vechen hi shechavla bevalah – lo hifsida ketubbatah, ammay? tezabbeninna nihaleh lichtubbeta levala betovat hanaa – beha chavala, dei machala legabbe vaal, lekka peseda!
Ha vadday rabbi meir hi, deamar: asur leadam sheyyeshahe et ishto afillu shaa achat belo ketubba.
Vetama may – kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah; hacha megaresh la, vegave leh bachavaleh minna. i hachi, hasheta name – megaresh la, vegave leh bachavaleh minna!
Kegon dinfisha[1] ketubbeta, demishshum hahu pureta la mafsed tuva.
Vei dinfisha ketubbeta mikketubba deorayyta, nokma akketubba deorayyta – veiddach tezabbena nihaleh bachavaleh!
Kegon dela nefisha ketubbeta mikketubba deorayyta; dehave chavaleh arbea zuze, demishshum arbea zuze la mafsed esrim vechamsha.
Ella ha detanya: keshem shello timkor vehi tachtav, kach lo tafsid vehi tachtav; veha zimnin mashkach la demafseda, vehechi dame – kegon dinfisha ketubbeta mikketubba deorayyta!
Amar rava: sefa atan lichtubbat benin dichrin.

Vehachi katane: keshem shehammocheret ketubbatah laacherim – lo hifsida ketubbat benin dichrin, may tama – zuze hu deansuha; kach mocheret ketubbatah levalah – lo hifsida ketubbat benin dichrin, may tama? zuze hu deansuha.
Lema takkanat usha tannae hi? detane chada: avde melog yotzin beshen vaayin laishsha, aval lo laish. vetanya iddach: lo laish velo laishsha.
Savruha, dechulle alma – kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame; may, lav beha ka mippalgi: deman deamar laishsha – let leh takkanat usha, uman deamar lo laish velo laishsha – it leh takkanat usha?
La; dechulle alma it lehu takkanat usha; ella kan kodem takkana, kan leachar takkana.
Vei baet ema: idde veidde leachar takkana, veit lehu takkanat usha; ella leman deamar laishsha velo laish – may tama? kidrava, deamar rava:

a: Hekdesh, chametz veshichrur – mafkiim mide shibud.
Lema derava tannae hi? la; dechulle alma it lehu derava, vehacha almu rabbanan leshibuda devaal.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma – let lehu lehane tannae takkanat usha, vehacha – bekinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame kamippalgi –
Uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: hammocher avdo leacher, ufasak immo al menat sheyyeshammeshennu sheloshim yom;
Rabbi meir omer: rishon yeshno bedin yom o yomayim, mippene shehu tachtav. kasavar: kinyan perot – kekinyan hagguf dame.
Rabbi yehuda omer: sheni yeshno bedin yom o yomayim, mippene shehu kaspo. kasavar: kinyan perot – lav kekinyan hagguf dame.

Rabbi yose omer: shenehem yeshnan bedin yom o yomayim; ze mippene shehu tachtav, veze mippene shehu kaspo. mesappeka leh kinyan perot i kekinyan hagguf dame i lav kekinyan hagguf dame, vesafek nefashot lehakel.
Rabbi eliezer omer: shenehem enan bedin yom o yomayim; ze lefi sheeno tachtav, veze lefi sheeno kaspo.
Amar rava: may tama derabbi eliezer? amar kera: "ki chaspo hu" – kaspo hameyuchad lo.
Keman azla ha deamar ammemar: ish veishsha shemmachru benichse melog – lo asu velo kelum? keman – kerabbi eliezer.

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin, vechen eved shel shene shuttafin – en yotzin berashe evarim sheenan chozrin? amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe, hachi amri mishshemeh derava: rabbi eliezer hi –
Mi la amar rabbi eliezer: "kaspo" – hameyuchad lo? hacha name, "avdo" – hameyuchad lo.
Mishna hattokea lachavero – noten lo sela. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili: mane. setaro – noten lo matayim zuz. leachar yado – noten lo arba meot zuz.
Tzaram beozno; talash bisaro; rakak – vehiggia bo rukko; heevir tallito mimmennu; para rosh haishsha bashshuk – noten lo arba meot zuz.
b: Ze hakkelal – hakkol lefi kevodo. amar rabbi akiva: afillu aniyyim shebbeyisrael, roin otam keillu hem bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem; shehem bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov.
Umaase beechad sheppara rosh haishsha bashshuk, bat lifne rabbi akiva, vechiyyeyvo litten lah arba meot zuz. amar lo: rabbi, ten li zeman. venatan lo zeman.
Shemarah omedet al petach chatzerah, veshavar et hakkad befaneha, uvo keissar shemen. gilleta et roshah, vehayta metappachat umannachat yadah al roshah.
Heemid aleha edim, uva lifne rabbi akiva; amar lo: lazo ani noten arba meot zuz?!
Amar lo: lo amarta kelum. hachovel beatzmo, af al pi sheeno rashshay – patur; acherim shechavlu bo – chayyayvim. vehakkotzetz netiotav, af al pi sheeno rashshay – patur; acherim – chayyayvin.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: mane tzori tenan, o mane medina tenan?
Ta shema: dehahu gavra ditka leh lechavreh. ata lekammeh derabbi yehuda nesia, amar leh: ha ana, ha rabbi yose haggelili, hav leh mane tzori. shema minna: mane tzori tenan! shema minna.
May "ha ana, ha rabbi yose haggelili"? illema hachi kaamar leh: ha ana – dachazetach, veha rabbi yose haggelili – deamar mane tzori, zil hav leh mane tzori. lememra deed naase dayyayn?!
Vehatanya: sanhedrin sherau echad sheharag et hannefesh – miktzatan naasu edim, umiktzatan naasu dayyaynin; divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer: kullam edim hem, veen ed naase dayyayn.
Ad kan la kaamar rabbi tarfon – ella demiktzatan naasu edim umiktzatan naasu dayyaynin; aval ed naase dayyayn – la kaamar!
Ki tanya hahi – kegon sherau ballayla, dela (lemebad) [bene mebad] dina ninhu.
Veibbaet ema, hachi kaamar leh: ha ana – disvira li kerabbi yose haggelili, deamar mane tzori; veha sahadi demashadi bach; zil hav leh mane tzori.
Vesavar rabbi akiva deen ed naase dayyayn?
Vehatanya: "vehikka ish et reehu beeven o veegrof" – shimon hattimni omer: ma egrof meyuchad – shemmasur laeda velaedim, af kol shemmasur laeda velaedim; perat lesheyyatzta mittachat yad haedim.
Amar lo rabbi akiva: vechi bifne bet din hikkahu – sheyyodin kamma hikkahu, veal ma hikkahu – im al shoko o tzippar nafsho?
Veod, hare sheddachaf et chavero merosh haggag o merosh habbira vamet – bet din holchin etzel bira, o vira holechet etzel bet din? veod, im nafla, chozer uvone?!
Ella ma egrof meyuchad – shehu masur laedim, af kol shehu masur laedim;
Perat lichsheyyatzta even mittachat yado shel makke – patur.
Katane mihat, amar lo rabbi akiva: vechi bifne bet din hikkahu, sheyyodin kamma hikkahu? ha hikkahu bifnehem – ed naase dayyayn!
Lidvarav derabbi shimon hattimni kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.
Tanu rabbanan: shor tam shehemit vehizzik – danin oto dine nefashot, veen danin oto dine mamonot.
Muad shehemit vehizzik – danin oto dine mamonot, vechozrin vedanin oto dine nefashot. kadmu vedanuhu dine nefashot – en chozrin vedanin oto dine mamonot.
Vechi kadmu vedanuhu dine nefashot may have? lihdar velidayyneh (name) [dine] mamonot!
Amar rava: ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav, deyatvi vekaamri: ha manni – rabbi shimon hattimni hi, deamar: "ma egrof meyuchad – shemmasur laeda velaedim",

a: Alma baenan umedana deve dina; veha, kevan digmar dineh liktala – la meshahenan leh leumedana deve dina, vela meannenan ledineh.
Veamena lehu ana: afillu tema rabbi akiva, hacha bemay askinan – kegon shebbarach.
I barach, ki lo danuhu dine nefashot – hechi dayyninan leh dine mamonot belo bealim? dekabbel sahadi uvarach.
Sof sof, mehecha mishtallam – meridya; i hachi, tam – nedayyneh dine mamonot beresha venishtallam meridya, vahadar nedayyneh dine nefashot!
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana, zot omeret: ridyay – aliyyay demare hu.
Ibbaya lehu: yesh omed linzakin, o en omed linzakin?
Mi amrinan: liktala hu deamdinan – behachi nafka neshama, behachi la nafka neshama; aval linzakin – kol dehu; o dilma la shena?

Ta shema: ma bor – sheyyesh bo kede lehamit, asara tefachim; af kol sheyyesh bo kede lehamit, asara tefachim. hayu pechutin measara tefachim, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet – patur. huzzak bo – chayyayv.
May, lav mimmatta lemala ka chashev – vehachi kaamar: mittefach vead asara – mita lekka, nezakin ikka? alma linzakin – kol dehu, shema minna en omdin linzakin!

Lo, mimmala lematta ka chashev; vehachi kaamar: asara – mita ikka; pachot measara pureta – nezakin ita, mita lekka. uleolam ema lach yesh omed linzakin, vechol midde umidde – ki hechi demittazka beh baenan.

Ta shema: hikkahu al eno vesimmeo, al ozno vechersho – eved yotze bahen lecherut. keneged eno – veeno roe, keneged ozno – veeno shomea, en eved yotze bahen lecherut. may tama? lav mishshum devaenan umedana – ushema minna: yesh umedana linzakin?

La; mishshum deamrinan: hu deavet nafsheh. kidtanya: hammavit et chavero – patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim. ketzad? taka beozno vechersho – patur, achazo vetaka beozno vechersho – chayyayv.
Ta shema: chamishsha devarim omdin oto, venotnin lo miyyad. rippuy vashevet – ad sheyyitrappe. amaduhu, vehaya mitnavne veholech – en notnin lo ella kemo sheamaduhu.

Amaduhu vehivri – notnin lo kol ma sheamaduhu. shema minna: yesh omed linzakin! lememad gavra, kamma likketzar meha makka kamma la mikketzar – la ka mibbee lan, devadday amdinan. ki ka mibbaya lan – lememad cheftza, i aved hay nizka o la. may?
Ta shema, shimon hattimni omer: ma egrof meyuchad – shemmasur laeda velaedim, af kol meyuchad shemmasur laeda velaedim. shema minna: yesh omed linzakin! shema minna.

Amar mar: amaduhu vehivri, notnin lo kol ma sheamaduhu. mesayyay leh lerava – deamar rava: hay man daamaduhu lechulle yoma, veittefach lefalga deyoma veka aved avidta – yahavinan leh. dechulle yoma min shemayya hu (derachame) [derachimu] aleh.
Rakak – vehiggia bo harok, veheevir kulei. amar rav pappa: lo shanu ella bo, aval bevigdo – la. venihve ki viyyesh bidvarim!
Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar avin, zot omeret: biyyeysho bidvarim – patur mikkelum.

Hakkol lefi chevodo [vechulei]. ibbaya lehu: tanna kamma lekulla kaamar, o lechumera kaamar? lekulla kaamar – deikka ani dela bae lemishkal kulle hay, o dilma lechumera kaamar – deikka ashir devae lemittav leh tefe?

Ta shema, middekaamar rabbi akiva: afillu aniyyim shebbeyisrael – roin otan keillu hen bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem, shehem bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov; shema minna, tanna kamma lekulla kaamar! shema minna.
Umaase beechad sheppara rosh haishsha [vechulei]. umi yahavinan zeman? vehaamar rabbi chanina: en notnin zeman lachavalot!
Ki la yahavinan leh zeman – lachavala, dechassereh mamona; aval levoshet, dela chassereh mamona – yahavinan.
Shemarah omedet al petach chatzerah vechulei. vehatanya, amar lo rabbi akiva: tzalalta bemayim addirim veheelita cheres beyadcha, adam rashshay lachbol beatzmo!
Amar rava: la kashya; kan bachavala, kan bevoshet. veha matnitin bevoshet hu,
b: Vekatane: hachovel beatzmo, af al pi sheeno rashshay – patur! hachi kaamar leh: la mibbaya boshet, deadam rashshay levayyesh et atzmo; ella afillu chavala, deen adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo – acherim shechavlu bo, chayyayvin.

Veen adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo? vehatanya: yachol nishba lehara beatzmo – velo hera, yehe patur? talmud lomar: "lehara o lehetiv" – ma hatava reshut, af haraa reshut; avi nishba lehara beatzmo velo hera!
Amar shemuel: beeshev betaanit".
Dichvota gabbe haraat acherim – lehoshivam betaanit; acherim mi motev lehu betaanita?!
In; dimhaddak lehu beinderona.
Vehatanya: ezehu haraat acherim? "akke peloni veeftza et mocho"!
Ella tannae hi; deikka leman deamar: en adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo, veikka man deamar: adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo.
Man tanna deshamat leh deamar: en adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo? illema hay tanna hu – detanya: "veach et dimchem lenafshotechem edrosh" – rabbi elazar omer: miyyad nafshotechem edrosh et dimchem;
Vedilma ketala shane!
Ella hay tanna hu – detanya: mekarin al hammet, velo middarche haemori. amar rabbi elazar: shamati shehamekarea al hammet yoter midday – loke mishshum "bal tashchit". vechol shekken gufo.

Vedilma begadim shane, difseda dela hadar hu! ki ha derabbi yochanan kare [lehu] lemane[] "mechabbedotay", verav chisda kad hava mesagge bene hizme (vehigge) [vehigge] – medalle lehu lemaneh, amar: ze maale arucha, veze eno maale arucha.

Ella hay tanna hu – detanya: amar rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi, ma talmud lomar: "vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh"? vechi beeze nefesh chata ze? ella shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin. vahalo devarim kal vechomer – uma ze, shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin, nikra chote; hametzaer atzmo mikkol davar, al achat kamma vechamma!

Hakkotzetz netiotav [vechulei]. tane rabba bar bar channa kammeh derav: "shori haragta", "netiotay katzatzta"; "atta amarta li lehorgo", "atta amrat li lekotztzo" – patur. amar leh: im ken, la shevakt chayye leviryayta! kol keminneh?!
Amar leh: esmeyay? amar leh: la; tittargam matnitach beshor haomed lahariga, uveilan haomed liktzitza.
I hachi, may ka taen leh? deamar leh: ana baena lemibad ha mitzva.
Detanya: "veshafach vechissa" – mi sheshshafach, yechasse. umaase beechad sheshshachat, vekadam chavero vechissa, vechiyyeyvo rabban gamliel litten lo asara zehuvim.
Amar rav: dikla ditan kabba – asur lemiktzetzeh.
Metivi: kamma yehe bazzayit velo yiktzetze[n]u? rova! shane zetim, dachashivi.
Amar rabbi chanina: la shechev shivchat beri, ella dekatz teenta bela zimna. amar ravina: veim haya meulle bedamim, muttar.
Tanya name hachi: "rak etz asher teda" – ze ilan maachol, "ki lo etz maachol hu" – ze ilan serak.
Vechi meachar shessofe[50]u lerabbot kol davar, ma talmud lomar "ki lo etz maachol"? lehakedim serak lemaachol.

a: Yachol afillu meulle bedamim? talmud lomar: "rak".
Shemuel ayyti leh ariseh tamre. achel, taem behu tama dechamra. amar leh: may hay? amar leh: bene gufene kayymi. amar: machchashi bechamra kulle hay? limchar ayyti li mikkorayyhu.
Rav chisda chaza tale be gufene. amar leh laariseh: akrinhu; gufene kane dikle, dikle la kane gufene.

Mishna af al pi shehu noten lo, en nimchal lo ad sheyyevakkesh mimmennu. shenneemar: "veatta hashev eshet vegomer". uminnayin sheim lo machal lo, shehu achzari? shenneemar: "vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim, vayyirpa elohim et avimelech vegomer".
Haomer "samme et eni"; "katta et yadi"; "shabber et ragli" – chayyayv. "al menat liftor" – chayyayv.
"Kera et kesuti"; "shabber et kaddi" – chayyayv. "al menat liftor" – patur. "ase ken leish peloni al menat liftor" – chayyayv, ben begufo ben bemamono.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: kol ellu sheamru – deme voshto; aval tzaaro – afillu hevi kol ele nevayot shebbaolam, en nimchal lo ad sheyyevakkesh mimmennu. shenneemar: "hashev eshet haish ki navi hu, veyitpallel baadcha".
Deeshet navi bae ahdore, eshet acher la bae ahdore?

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: "hashev eshet haish" – mikkol makom. udeka amrat: "hagoy gam tzaddik taharog?! halo hu amar li achoti hi, vehi gam hi amra achi hu!" navi hu, uchevar limmed: achsenay shebba lair – al iske achila ushetiyya shoalin oto, o al iske ishto shoalin oto – "ishtecha hi?" "achotcha hi?"
Mikkan leven noach shenneherag, shehaya lo lilmod velo lamad.
"Ki atzor atzar Adonai" – amar rabbi elazar: shete atzirot hallalu lamma? achat beish – shichvat zera, shetayim beishsha – shichvat zera veleda.
Bematnita tena: shetayim beish – shichvat zera uketannim, shelosha baishsha – shichvat zera uketannim veleda.
Ravina amar: shalosh beish – shichvat zera uketannim ufi tabbaat, arbaa beishsha – shichvat zera veleda uketannim ufi tabbaat.
"Bead kol rechem" – amri deve rabbi yannay: afillu tarnegolet shel bet avimelech lo hetila betzatah.

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan: kol hamevakkesh rachamim al chavero vehu tzarich leoto davar, hu naane techilla? amar leh: dichtiv: "vaAdonai shav et shevut iyyov behitpallo bead reehu".

Amar leh: at amrat mehatam, vaana amena mehacha: "vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim, vayyirpa elohim et avimelech veet ishto veamhotav [vegomer]", uchetiv: "vaAdonai pakad et sara kaasher amar vegomer" – kaasher amar avraham el avimelech.
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari: mena ha milleta deamri inashe: bahade hutza lake kerava? amar leh, dichtiv: "lamma tarivu elay? kullechem peshatem bi neum Adonai".
Amar leh: at amrat mehatam, vaana amena mehacha: "ad ana meantem lishmor mitzvotay vetorotay".
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari: ketiv: "umiktze echav lakach chamishsha anashim" – man ninhu chamishsha? amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: otan shehucheplu beshemot.
Yehuda name ikkefole mikkefal!
Amar leh: lemilleteh hu deikkefal. deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, may dichtiv: "yechi reuven veal yamot, vihi metav mispar – vezot lihuda"?
Kol otan arbaim shana shehayu yisrael bammidbar, hayu atzmotav shel yehuda megulegalin baaron; ad shebba moshe uvikkesh rachamim – amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mi garam liruven sheyyode – yehuda!

Miyyad: "shema Adonai kol yehuda" – al evreh leshafa. la havo ka masseki [leh] limtivta dirkia, "veel ammo teviennu". la hava yada may kaamri rabbanan, ulemishkal umitrach bahade rabbanan, "yadav rav lo". la hava salek leh shemateta allibba dehilcheta, "veezer mitztzarav tihye".

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: batar anya azla anyuta? amar leh, ditnan: ashirim meviin bikkurim biklatot shel zahav veshel kesef, vaaniyyim besalle netzarim shel arava kelufa. hassallim vehabbikkurim netunim lakkohanim. amar leh: at amrat mehatam, vaana amena mehacha:
b: "Vetame tame yikra".

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan: hashekem veechol bakkayitz mippene hachamma, uvachoref mippene hatztzinna; veamri inashe: shittin rahote rehut, vela meto legavra demitztzafra kerach? dichtiv: "lo yiravu velo yitzmau, velo yakkem sharav vashamesh".

Amar leh: at amrat mehatam, vaana amena mehacha: "vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem" – zo keriyyat shema utefilla. "uverach [et] lachmecha veet memecha" – zo pat bemelach vekiton shel mayim. mikkan veelach: "vahasiroti machala mikkirbecha".

Vetanya: machala – zo mara. velamma nikra shemah machala? sheshshemonim ushelosha cholain yesh bah – "machala" begimatriyya hachi havu. vechullan, pat bammelach shacharit vekiton shel mayim – mevattelan.

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan: chavrach karyaych "chamara" – ukkafa legabbaych mush? amar leh, dichtiv: "vayyomar: hagar shifchat saray, e mizze vat veana telechi? vattomer: mippene saray gevirti anochi borachat".
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: milleta genaa deit baych – kedem amra? amar leh, dichtiv: "vayyomar: eved avraham anochi".
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: shafel veazel bar avoza, veeneh metayyeyfi? amar leh, dichtiv: "vehetiv Adonai ladoni, vezacharta [et] amatecha".

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: shittin tichle matyu lechakka dekal chavreh shema, vela achal? amar leh, dichtiv: "veli ani avdecha uletzadok hakkohen velivnayahu ven yehoyada velishlomo avdecha lo kara".

Amar leh: at amrat mehatam, vaana amena mehacha: "vayvieha yitzchak haohela sara immo, vayyikkach et rivka vattehi lo leishsha vayyeehaveha, vayyinnachem yitzchak achare immo", uchetiv batreh: "vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushemah ketura".

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: chamra lemareh, tevuta leshakyeh? amar leh, dichtiv: "vesamachta et yadcha alav" – "lemaan yishmeun veyirun kol adat bene yisrael". uchetiv: "vihoshua bin nun male ruach chochma, ki samach moshe et yadav alav, vayyishmeu elav kol bene yisrael vegomer".
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: kalba bechafneh – gelale (40)bala? dichtiv: "nefesh sevea – tavus nofet, venefesh reeva – kol mar, matok".

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: metayyel veazel dikla bisha gabbe kinna dishrache? amar leh: davar ze katuv battora, shanuy banneviim, umeshullash bakketuvim; utenan bematnitin, utenena bevarayyta.

Katuv battora – dichtiv: "vayyelech esav el yishmael". shanuy banneviim – dichtiv: "vayyitlakketu el yiftach anashim rekim, vayyihyu immo". umeshullash bakketuvim – dichtiv: "kol of lemino yishkon, (uvene) [uven] adam laddome lo". tenan bematnitin – kol hamechubbar lattame, tame; kol hamechubbar lattahor, tahor. utenena bevarayyta – rabbi eliezer omer: lo lechinnam halach zarzir etzel orev, ella mippene shehu mino.
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: karet chavrach vela anach, remi gudda rabba – shedi beh? amar leh: "yaan tihartich velo tahart mittumatech – lo tithari od".

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: bera dishtet minneh – la tishde beh kala? amar leh, dichtiv: "lo tetaev adomi – ki achicha hu, velo tetaev mitzri – ki ger hayita veartzo".

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: i delet dura – dalena, vei la – la dalena? amar leh, dichtiv: "vayyomer eleha barak: im telchi immi – vehalachti, veim lo telchi immi – lo elech".

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: kad havenan zutere – legavre, hasheta dekashshishna – ledardeke? amar leh, meikkara ketiv: "vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan lanchotam hadderech, velayla beammud esh lehair lahem", ulevassof ketiv:

a: "Hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha, lishmarcha baddarech".
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, mena ha milleta deamri inashe: batar mare nichse – tzive meshoch? amar leh, dichtiv: "vegam lelot haholech et avram haya tzon uvakar veohalim".

Amar rav chanan: hammoser din al chavero – hu neenash techilla. shenneemar: "vattomer saray el avram: chamasi alecha", uchetiv: "vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah". vehane mille deit leh dina beara.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: oy lo latztzoek yoter min hannitzak. tanya name hachi: echad hatztzoek veechad hannitzak bammashma, ella shemmemaharin latztzoek yoter min hannitzak.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: leolam al tehi killat hedyot kalla beenecha. shehare avimelech killel et sara, venitkayyem bezarah. shenneemar: "hinne hu lach kesut enayim" – amar lah: hoil vechissit mimmenni velo gillit shehu ishech, vegaramt li hatztzaar hazze, yehi ratzon sheyyehu lach banim kesuye enayim. venitkayyem bezarah – dichtiv: "vayhi ki zaken yitzchak, vattichhena enav merot".
Amar rabbi avahu: leolam yehe adam min hannirdafin, velo min harodfin. sheen lecha nirdof baofot yoter mittorim uvene yona, vehichshiran hakkatuv legabbe mizbeach.
Haomer "samme et eni" kulei. amar leh rav assi bar chama lerava: may shena resha, umay shena sefa?
Amar leh: resha – lefi sheen adam mochel al rashe evarim.
Amar leh: vechi adam mochel al tzaaro?! detanya: "hakkeni, petzaeni, al menat liftor" – patur! ishtik.
Amar: midde shemia lach beha? amar leh, hachi amar rav sheshet: mishshum pegam mishpacha.
Ittemar, rabbi oshaya amar: mishshum pegam mishpacha. rava amar: mishshum sheen adam mochel al rashe evarim shello.
Rabbi yochanan amar: yesh "hen" shehu kelav", veyesh "lav" shehu kehen".
Tanya name hachi: "hakkeni, petzaeni", "al menat liftor?" veamar lo "hen" – hare yesh "hen" shehu kelav". "kera et kesuti", "al menat liftor?" veamar lo: "lav" – hare "lav" shehu kehen".
"Shabber et kaddi", "kera et kesuti" – chayyayv. ureminhi: "lishmor" – velo leabbed, "lishmor" – velo likroa, "lishmor" – velo lechallek laaniyyim!
Amar rav huna: la kashya; ha daatay lideh, ha dela atay lideh.
Amar leh rabba: "lishmor" – daatay lideh mashma!
Ella amar rabba: ha veha daata lideh, vela kashya; ha daata lideh betorat shemira, ha daata lideh betorat keria.
Hahu arneka ditzdaka daatay lefumebdita, afkeda rav yosef gabbe hahu gavra. pesha ba, ato gannave ganvuha. chayyeyveh rav yosef. amar leh abbaye, vehatanya: "lishmor" – velo lechallek laaniyyim!
Amar leh: anye defumebdita mikkatz kitz lehu, velishmor" hu.
Hadaran alach hachovel
b: Mishna haggozel etzim vaasaan kelim, tzemer vaasaan begadim – meshallem kishat haggezela.
Gazal para meubberet – veyalda, rachel teuna – ugezazah; meshallem deme fara haomedet leled, udeme rachel haomedet liggazez.
Gazal para – venitabbera etzlo veyalda, rachel – venitana etzlo ugezazah; meshallem kishat haggezela. ze hakkelal: kol haggazlanim meshallemin kishat haggezela.
Gemara amri: etzim vaasaan kelim – in, shippan – la; tzemer vaasaan begadim – in, libbenan – la.
Ureminhi: gazal etzim veshippan, avanim vesittetan, tzemer (velibbenan) [velibbeno], pishtan venikkahu – meshallem kishat haggezela.
Amar abbaye: tanna didan katane shinnuy derabbanan – dehadar, vechol shekken shinnuy deorayyta;

Etzim vaasaan kelim – beetzim meshuppin, umay ninhu? nesarim; deshinnuy dehadar livriyyayteh hu – dei bae meshallef lehu. tzemer vaasaan begadim – betzemer tavuy; deshinnuy dahadar livriyyayteh hu – dei bae satar leh. vechol shekken shinnuy deorayyta.
Vetanna bara – shinnuy deorayyta katane, veshinnuy derabbanan la katane.
Rav ashe amar, tanna didan name shinnuy deorayyta katane: etzim vaasaan kelim – buchane, dehayynu shippan; tzemer vaasaan begadim – namte, dehayynu shinnuy dela hadar.
Velibbun mi have shinnuy? ureminhi: lo hispik litteno lo ad shetztzevao – patur. libbeno velo tzevao – chayyayv!
Amar abbaye: la kashya; ha rabbi shimon, ha rabbanan. detanya: gezazo, tevoo vaarago – en mitztaref. libbeno – rabbi shimon omer: en mitztaref, vachachamim omrim: mitztaref.
Rava amar: ha veha rabbi shimon, vela kashya; ha denappetzeh nappotze, ha disarkeh saroke.
Rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar: ha dechavvevreh chauore, ha dechavreh kavroye.

Hasheta yesh lomar tzeva lerabbi shimon la have shinnuy, libbun have shinnuy? detanya: gazaz rishon rishon utzevao, rishon rishon utevoo, rishon rishon vaarago – en mitztaref. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: tzevao – mitztaref.
Amar abbaye: la kashya; ha rabbanan allibba derabbi shimon, ha rabbi shimon ben yehuda allibba derabbi shimon.

Rava amar: leolam la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi shimon ben yehuda, veshane tzeva – hoil veyachol lehaaviro al yede tzafon. vechi katane hatam: lo hispik litteno lo ad shetztzevao – patur, veokimna kedivre hakkol; bekala ilan dela avar.

Amar abbaye: rabbi shimon ben yehuda, uvet shammay, verabbi eliezer ben yaakov, verabbi shimon ben elazar, verabbi yishmael – kullehu sevira lehu: shinnuy bimkomo omed. rabbi shimon ben yehuda – ha daamaran.
Bet shammay may hi? detanya: natan lah chittin beetnannah, vaasaan solet; zetim vaasaan shemen; anavim vaasaan yayin – tane chada: asur, vetanya iddach: muttar. veamar rav yosef, tane gureyon

a: Demeasporak: bet shammay osrin, uvet hillel mattirin. may tameh devet shammay? amar kera: "gam shenehem" – lerabbot shinnuyehem. uvet hillel – amar kera: "hem" – velo shinnuyehem.
Uvet shammay, ha ketiv "hem"! hahu mibbee leh "hem" – velo valdotehem. uvet hillel – tarte shamat minna. "hem" velo shinnuyehem, "hem" velo valdotehem.
Uvet hillel name, hachtiv: "gam"! "gam" levet hillel kashya.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov may hi?

Detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: hare sheggazal sea shel chittin, techanah, lashah vaafaah, vehifrish mimmenna challa, ketzad mevarech? en ze mevarech ella menaetz! veal ze neemar: "botzea berech nietz Adonai".
Rabbi shimon ben elazar may hi? detanya, kelal ze amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: kol shevach shehishbiach gazlan – yado al haelyona. ratza notel shivcho, ratza omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha".
May kaamar? amar rav sheshet, hachi kaamar: hishbiach – notel shivcho. kachash – omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha", deshinnuy bimkomo omed.
I hachi, afillu hishbiach name! amri: mippene takkanat hashshavim.
Rabbi yishmael may hi? detanya: mitzvat pea – lehaferish min hakkama. lo hifrish min hakkama – mafrish min haomarim. lo hifrish min haomarim – mafrish min hakkeri ad shello mercho.
Mercho – measser venoten lo. mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: af mafrish min haissa venoten lo.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ikkeful kol hane tannae leashmoinan kevet shammay?! amar leh, hachi kaamri: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze.
Amar rava: mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi shimon ben yehuda hatam, ella betzeva – hoil veyachol lehaaviro al yede tzafon;
Vead kan la kaamri bet shammay hatam, ella legavoah – mishshum deimmeis;
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hatam, ella leinyan beracha – mishshum dehave leh mitzva habbaa baavera;
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar hatam ella behachechasha dehadar;
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael hatam, ella leinyan pea – mishshum dichtiv "taazov" yattira! vechi tema ligmar minneh, mattenot aniyyim shane!
Kidvae rabbi yonatan – devae rabbi yonatan: may tama derabbi yishmael – mishshum dekasavar shinnuy eno kone? o dilma, bealma kasavar shinnuy kone; vehacha mishshum dichtiv "taazov" yattira?
Veim timtze lomar tama derabbi yishmael mishshum dekasavar shinnuy eno kone, "taazov" yattira dichtav rachamana lema li? vetu, lerabbanan – "taazov" yattira dichtav rachamana lema li?
Mibbee leh lechidtanya: hammafkir karmo, vehishkim labboker uvetzaro – chayyayv beferet uveolelot uveshichcha uvefea, ufatur min hammaaser.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar.
Umi amar shemuel hachi?! vehaamar shemuel: en shamin lo legannav velo legazlan, ella linzakin.

Bishlama lerava, deamar: ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar hatam – behachechasha dehadar, la kashya; ki kaamar halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar, deshinnuy bimkomo omed – behachechasha dehadar, vechi kaamar shemuel hatam: en shamin lo legannav velo legazlan, ella linzakin – behachechasha dela hadar.
Ella leabbaye, deamar: ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar – behachechasha dela hadar kaamar, may ikka lememar?
Abbaye matne hachi – amar rav yehuda amar shemuel:
b: Amru halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar. veleh la sevira leh.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: devar tora – gezela hannishtannet, chozeret beeneha. shenneemar: "veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal" – mikkol makom. veim tomar: mishnatenu! mishshum takkanat hashshavim.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: lo hispik litteno lo ad shetztzevao – patur!
Amar lehu hahu midderabbanan – verabbi yaakov shemeh: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yochanan – kegon sheggazal etzim meshuppin vaasaan kelim, dehave leh shinnuy hachozer livriyyayto.
Tanu rabbanan: haggazlanin umalve beribbit shehechziru – en mekabbelin mehen. vehamekabbel mehen – en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu.

Amar rabbi yochanan: bime rabbi nishnet mishna zo. detanya: maase beadam echad shebbikkesh laasot teshuva, amra lo ishto: reka! im atta ose teshuva, afillu avnet eno shellecha! venimna velo asa teshuva. beotah shaa amru: haggazlanin umalve ribbiyyot shehechziru – en mekabbelin mehem, vehamekabbel mehem – en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu.
Metivi: hinniach lahem avihem maot shel ribbit, af al pi shehen yodin shehen ribbit – en chayyayvin lehachezir. inhu hu dela, ha avihem chayyayv lehachezir.

Bedin hu daavihem name eno chayyayv lehachezir; veha dekatane bedidhu – mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa: "hinniach lahem avihem para vetallit vechol davar hamesuyyaym – chayyayvin lehachezir mippene kevod avihem", tena resha name bedidhu.
Umippene kevod avihem – chayyayvin lehachezir? ekre kan: "venasi veammecha lo taor" – beose maase ammecha?!
Kidamar rav pinchas: besheasa teshuva; hacha name, besheasa teshuva. i asa teshuva, may bae gabbeh? ibbei leh leahdore! shello hispik lehachezir ad shemmet.
Ta shema: haggazlanim umalve beribbit, af al pi sheggavu – machazirin.
Gazlanin – may "sheggavu" ikka? i gezul – gezul, vei la gezul – la gezul! ella ema: haggazlanin, umay nihu – malve ribbiyyot; af al pi sheggavu – machzirin! amri: machzirin, veen mekabbelin mehem.
Ella lamma machzirin? latzet yede shamayim.
Ta shema: haroim vehaggabbain vehammochsin – teshuvatan kasha, umachzirin lemakkirin!
Amri: machzirin, veen mekabbelin mehem. veella lamma machzirin? latzet yede shamayim. i hachi, ammay teshuvatan kasha?
Veod, ema sefa: vesheen makkirin – yaase bahen tzorche tzibbur, veamar rav chisda: borot, shichin umearot! ella la kashya; kan kodem takkana, kan leachar takkana.
Vehasheta deamar rav nachman: besheen gezela kayyemet – afillu tema idde veidde leachar takkana; vela kashya,

a: Kan bigzela kayyemet, kan besheen gezela kayyemet. veha avnet – digzela kayyemet hi! may "avnet" – deme avnet.

Vechol hecha digzela kayyemet, la avud rabbanan takkanta?! vahare marish, digzela kayyemet hi; utenan: al hammarish haggazul shebbenao babbira, sheyyittol damav – mippene takkanat hashshavim! shane hatam, dechevan deikka peseda devira – shavveyuha rabbanan kidleta.

Gazal para meubberet veyalda vechulei. tanu rabbanan: haggozel rachel ugezazah, para veyalda – meshallem otah veet gizzoteha veet valdoteha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: gezela chozeret beeneha. rabbi shimon omer: roin otah keillu hi shuma etzlo bechesef.
Ibbaya lehu: may tameh derabbi meir – mishshum dekasavar: shinnuy bimkomo omed? o dilma, bealma shinnuy kone, vehacha kenasa hu deka kanes?
Lemay nafka minna? lehecha dichchasha michchash.
Ta shema: gazal behema vehizkina, avadim vehizkinu – meshallem kishat haggezela. rabbi meir omer, baavadim omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha". veillu behema – kishat haggezela;
Vei salka datach savar rabbi meir shinnuy bimkomo omed, afillu behema name! ella lav shema minna, kasavar rabbi meir shinnuy kone – vehacha kenasa hu deka kanes?

Amri, rabbi meir ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi – shinnuy en kone, vaafillu behema name. ella ledidchu, deamritu shinnuy kone – odo li mihat beavda, dechimkarkee dame, vekarka enah nigzelet! veamri leh rabbanan: la, avda kemittalteli dame.

Ta shema: litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor, shachor utzevao adom – rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme tzamro. deme tzamro – in, deme tzamro veshivcho – la; vei salka datach savar rabbi meir shinnuy en kone, deme tzamro veshivcho bae lemittav leh!
Ella lav shema minna, kasavar rabbi meir shinnuy kone, vehacha kenasa hu deka kanes? shema minna.

Ikka deamri: ha – la ibbei lan; middeafech rav vetane: "gazal para vehizkina, avadim vehizkinu – meshallem kishat haggezela, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: baavadim – omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha" – vadday lerabbi meir shinnuy kone, vehacha kenasa hu deka kanes leh.
Ki ka ibbei lan – hachi ibbei lan: ki ka kanes – bemezid, aval beshogeg la kanes; o dilma afillu beshogeg name kanes?
Ta shema: chamishsha govin min hamechorarin,
Veellu hen: perot, ushevach perot, vehamekabbel alav lazun ben ishto uvat ishto, veget chov sheen bo achrayut, uchetubbat ishsha sheen bah achrayut.
Man shamat leh deamar: achrayut – lav taut sofer hu? rabbi meir; vekatane: perot ushevach perot.
Shevach perot hechi dame? kegon sheggazal sade mechavero umecharah leacher, vehishbichah, vahare hi yotza mittachat yado. keshehu gove,
b: Gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshuebadim, veet hashshevach minnechasim bene chorin. deate baal ara, veshakel areh ushevacheh.

May, lav beam haaretz – dela yada dekarka nigzelet o enah nigzelet, vaafillu hachi kaate baal karka veshakel leara ushevacha, ushema minna: beshogeg name kanes? amri: la; belokeach talmid chacham, veyada.
Ta shema: litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor, shachor utzevao adom – rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme tzamro. deme tzamro – in, deme tzamro veshivcho – la;
Vei salka datach beshogeg name kanes, deme tzamro veshivcho bae lemitteva leh! ella lav shema minna: bemezid kanes, beshogeg la kanes? shema minna.
Rabbi yehuda omer: gezela chozeret beeneha. rabbi shimon omer: roin otah keillu hi shuma etzlo bechesef. may benayyhu?
Amar rav zevid: beshevach sheal gabbe gezela kamippalgi – rabbi yehuda savar: denigzal have, verabbi shimon savar: degazlan have.

Rav pappa amar: dechulle alma, shevach sheal gabbe gezela – degazlan have; vehacha lemechetza, lishlish velirvia kamippalgi – rabbi yehuda savar: shevach sheal gabbe gezela – kulleh degazlan have, verabbi shimon savar: lemechetza, lishlish velirvia hu deshakel gazlan.
Tenan: gazal para, venitabbera etzlo veyalda; rachel, venitana etzlo ugezazah – meshallem kishat haggezela. yalda – in, lo yalda – hadra beena;

Bishlama lerav zevid, deamar: shevach sheal gabbe gezela – denigzal have lerabbi yehuda; ha manni – rabbi yehuda hi. ella lerav pappa, deamar: degazlan have – ha manni? la rabbi yehuda, vela rabbi shimon!
Amar lecha rav pappa: hu haddin afillu lo yalda name – kishat haggezela hu dimshallem, veha dekatane "yalda" – ayyeyde denasev resha "yalda", nasev sefa name "yalda".
Tanya kevoteh derav pappa, rabbi shimon omer: roin otah keillu hi shuma etzlo bechesef – lemechetza, lishlish velirvia.
Amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav kahana, ibbaya lan: lerabbi shimon deamar lemechetza, lishlish velirvia hu deshakel gazlan, ki mesallekinan leh – bidme mesallekinan leh, o dilma mibbisra shakel?
Ufeshatna meha deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: shelosha shamin lahen hashshevach, umaalin otan bedamim; veellu hen: bechor lefashut,
Uvaal chov lelokeach, uvaal chov litomim.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, mi amar shemuel: baal chov lelokeach yahev leh shevach? vehaamar shemuel: baal chov gove et hashshevach! amar leh: la kashya, kan beshevach hammaggia lichtefayim, vechan beshevach sheen maggia lichtefayim.
Amar leh: veha maasim bechol yom, veka magbe shemuel afillu shevach hammaggia lichtefayim! amar leh: la kashya;

a: Ha demassek beh keshiur ara ushevacha, ha dela massek beh ella keshiur ara.

Amar leh, hanicha leman deamar: i it leh zuze lelokeach – la matze mesallek leh levaal chov, shappir. ella leman deamar: i it leh zuze lelokeach – matze mesallek leh levaal chov, lema leh: i havo li zuze – hava mesallekna lach mikkulleh ara, hasheta – hav li geriva deara shiur shevachay!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon deshavveya nihaleh appoteke, daamar leh: lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizze.
Amar rava: gazal vehishbiach umachar, vegazal vehishbiach vehorish – ma shehishbiach machar, ma shehishbiach horish.
Bae rava: hishbiach lokeach, mahu? batar devaya, hadar pashta: ma machar rishon lashsheni? kol zechut shettavo leyado.
Bae rava: hishbiach goy, mahu? amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: takkanta legoy neku venabed?! amar leh: la tzericha, kegon dezabbeneh leyisrael. sof sof, habba mechamat goy hare hu kegoy!

La tzericha, kegon degazla[] yisrael vezabbena nihaleh, vehishbichah goy, vahadar goy vezabbena leyisrael. may? mi amrinan kevan demeikkara yisrael vahadar yisrael – avdi rabbanan takkanta, o dilma kevan deikka goy baemtza – la avadu leh rabbanan takkanta? teku.

Amar rav pappa: hay man digzal dikla mechavreh vekatleh, af al gav deshadye meara leara dideh, la kene. may tama? meikkara "dikla" mikkere, vehasheta name "dikla" mikkere. dikla (vaaved) [veavdeh] gubbe, la kane. hasheta mihat "gubbe dedikla" mikkere.
Gubbe veavdinhu keshure – kane. keshure ravreve veavdinhu keshure zutere – la kane. avdinhu ketzutzeyayta – kane.

Amar rava: hay man digzal lulibba veavdinhu hutze – kane. demeikkara "lulibba" mikkere, vehasheta "hutze". hutze veavdinhu chufeya – kane. meikkara "hutze", vehasheta "chufeya". chufeya veavdeh sharshura – la kane. may tama? dahadar satar leh vehave chufeya.
Bae rav pappa: nechleka hatteyomet, mahu? ta shema, deamar rabbi matun amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nittela hatteyomet – pasul.
b: May, lav hu haddin lenechleka? la; nittela shane, deha chasar le.
Ikka deamri: ta shema, deamar rabbi matun amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nechleka hatteyomet – naasa kemi shennittela, ufasul! shema minna.

Amar rav pappa: hay man digzal afra mechavreh, veavdeh leventa – la kane. may tama? dehadar meshavve leh afra. leventa veavday afra – kane. may amrat – dilma hadar veaved leh leventa? hay leventa achariti hu, ufanim chadashot bau lechan.

Veamar rav pappa: hay man digzal nesacha mechavreh, (veaved) [veavdeh] zuze – la kane. may tama? hadar aved lehu nesacha. zuze veavdinhu nesacha – kane. may amrat – hadar aved lehu zuze? panim chadashot bau lechan.
Shechime veavdinhu chadte – la kane. chadte veavdinhu shechime – kane. may amrat – hadar aved lehu chadte? midda yedia shichmayyhu.
