Ze hakkelal: kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela. "ze hakkelal" leetoye may? leetoye ha deamar rabbi ila: ganav tale venaasa ayil, egel venaasa shor – naasa shinnuy beyado, ukenao. tavach umachar – shello hu toveach, shello hu mocher.
Hahu gavra digzal paddana detore mechavreh, azal kerav behu kerava, zera behu zara. lesof ahderinhu lemareh. ata lekammeh derav nachman, amar lehu: zilu shumu shevacha deashbach.

Amar leh rava: tore ashbuch, ara la ashbach?! amar: mi kaamena neshayyeymu kulleh? palga kaamena! amar leh: sof sof, gezela hu – veka hadra beena, ditnan: kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela!
Amar leh: la amena lach, ki yatevna bedina la tema li midde, deamar huna chavrin alay: "ana veshabbur malka – ache bedina"? hay inash gazlana attika hu, uvaena deekneseh.
Mishna gazal behema vehizkina, avadim vehizkinu – meshallem kishat haggezela. rabbi meir omer: baavadim – omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha".
Gazal matbea venisdak; perot vehirkivu; yayin vehechmitz – meshallem kishat haggezela.
Matbea venifsal; teruma venitmet; chametz veavar alav happesach; behema venitabbeda bah avera, o shennifsela meal gabbe hammizbeach, o shehayta yotza lissakel – omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha".
Gemara amar rav pappa: lo "hizkina" – hizkina mammash, ella afillu kachasha. veha anan "hizkina" tenan! kachasha kegon hizkina, dela hadra[1] barya.

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe, hachi kaamri mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: afillu ganav tale venaasa ayil, egel venaasa shor – naasa shinnuy beyado, ukenao. tavach umachar – shello hu toveach, shello hu mocher. amar leh, lav amena lach: la tachlef gavre? hahu mishshemeh derabbi ila ittemar.

Rabbi meir omer, baavadim omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha". amar rav chanina bar avdimi amar rav: halacha kerabbi meir. verav shavek rabbanan veaved kerabbi meir? amri: mishshum devarayyta ippecha tanya. verav shavek matnitin veaved kevarayyta? rav – matnitin name ippecha tane.
Umay tameh derav deafech matnitin mikkamme devarayyta? adderabba, nefoch levarayyta mikkamme matnitin! amri: rav name matnitin ippecha atnuyah.
Vei baet ema: ki la afech – chada mikkamme chada; chada mikkamme tarte – afech.
Detanya: hammachlif para bachamor, veyalda; vechen hammocher shifchato, veyalda; ze omer "birshuti yalda", vehalla shotek – zacha bah. ze omer "eni yodea", veze omer "eni yodea" – yachloku.
Ze omer "birshuti" veze omer "birshuti" – yishshava hammocher shebbirshuto yalda, lefi shekkol hannishbain shebbattora – nishbain velo meshallemin; divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: en nishbain lo al haavadim velo al hakkarkaot.
Hay "halacha kerabbi meir"?! "halacha kerabbanan" mibbee leh! hachi kaamar: lemay deafchitu vetanetu, halacha kerabbi meir.

a: Umi amar rav avda kimkarkee dame? vehaamar rav daniel bar rav kattina amar rav: hattokef beavdo shel chavero veasa bo melacha – patur. vei salka datach avda kimkarkee dame, ammay patur? birshuta demareh kae!

Hacha bemay askinan – shello bishat melacha. ki ha dishlach leh rabbi abba lemare bar mar, bei minneh merav huna: haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato, tzarich lehaalot lo sachar o en tzarich lehaalot lo sachar? ushelachu leh: eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar.
Hachi hasheta?! bishlama hatam, ben leman deamar beta meyatteva yatev – nicha leh, ben leman deamar "usheiyya yukkat shaar" – nicha leh.
Ella hacha, mi nicha leh denichchosh avdeh? amri: hachi name, nicha leh dela listere avdeh.

(Be) rav yosef bar chama havo[5] takef avde deinashe demassek behu zuze, veaved behu melacha. amar leh rabba bereh: may tama aved mar hachi? amar leh, deamar rav nachman: avda – nehom kereseh la shave. amar leh: ema deamar rav nachman kegon daru avdeh – dimrakked be chubbe; kullehu avde mebad avdi!
Amar leh: ana kerav daniel sevira li – deamar rav daniel bar rav kattina amar rav: hattokef beavdo shel chavero veasa bo melacha – patur. alma nicha leh, dela listere avdeh.

Amar leh: hane mille hecha dela massek behu zuze; mar, kevan demassek behu zuze – michaze keribbit. deamar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman, af al pi sheamru: haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato – en tzarich lehaalot lo sachar, hilvahu vedar bachatzar chavero – tzarich lehaalot lo sachar! amar leh: hadari bi.
Ittemar: hattokef sefinato shel chavero veasa bah melacha, amar rav: ratza – secharah notel, ratza – pechatah notel. ushemuel amar: eno notel ella pechatah.
Amar rav pappa: la peligi; ha daavida leagra, ha dela avida leagra. veibbaet ema: ha veha daavida leagra; ha dinchet leh addata deagra, veha dinchet leh addata degazlanuta.
Gazal matbea venisdak [vechulei]. amar rav huna: "nisdak" – nisdak mammash, "nifsal" – pesalattu malchut.
Verav yehuda amar: pesalattu malchut name – hayeynu nisdak. ella hechi dame "nifsal"? sheppesalattu medina zo, veyotze bimdina acheret.
Amar leh rav chisda lerav huna: ledidach deamrat "nifsal" – pesalattu malchut; hare perot vehirkivu, yayin vehechmitz – dechi pesalattu malchut dame; vekatane: meshallem kishat haggezela!
Amar leh: hatam nishtanna tamo verecho, hacha lo nishtanna.
Amar leh rava lerav yehuda: ledidach deamrat pesalattu malchut name hayeynu "nisdak"; hare teruma venitmet, dechi pesalattu malchut dame, vekatane: omer lo "hare shellecha lefanecha"!
Amar leh: hatam la minnechar hezzeka, hacha minnechar hezzeka.
Ittemar: hammalve et chavero al hammatbea, venifsal hammatbea, rav amar:
b: Noten lo matbea hayyotze beotah shaa. ushemuel amar: yachol lomar lo, lech hotzio bemeshan. amar rav nachman: mistabbera milleteh dishmuel – deit leh orcha lemezal lemeshan, aval let leh orcha – la.

Etiveh rava lerav nachman: en mechallelin al hammaot sheenam yotzot. ketzad? hayu lo maot kozviyyot yerushalmiyyot, o shel melachim harishonim – en mechallelin. ha shel acharonim dumeya derishonim – mechallelin!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kesheen malchiyyot makpidot zo al zo.
Ella ki amar shemuel – keshemmalchiyyot makpidot zo al zo. hechi matze mamte lehu? demamte le[u] al yede haddechak; dela bachashi, vei mashkechi kafdi.

Ta shema: en mechallelin al maot shel kan vehen bevavel, veshel bavel vehen kan. shel bavel vehen bevavel – mechallelin. katane mihat: en mechallelin al maot shel kan vehen bevavel – af al gav desofo lemissak lehatam!
Hacha bemay askinan – keshemmalchiyyot makpidot zo al zo. i hachi, shel bavel vehen bevavel lemay chazu? chazu dezaven behu behema, umassek lirushalayim.

Vehatanya: hitkinu sheyyehu hammaot yotzot birushalayim mippene kach! amar rabbi zera, la kashya: kan bizman sheyyad yisrael takkifa al ummot haolam, kan bizman sheyyad ummot haolam takkifa al atzman.

Tanu rabbanan: ezehu matbea shel yerushalayim? david ushelomo mitztzad echad, virushalayim ir hakkodesh mitztzad acher. veezehu matbea shel avraham avinu? zaken uzekena mitztzad echad, uvachur uvetula mitztzad acher.

Bea minneh rava merav chisda: hammalve et chavero al hammatbea, vehosifu alav, mahu? amar lo: noten lo matbea hayyotze beotah shaa. amar leh: vaafillu ki nafya? amar leh: in. amar leh: afillu ki teritay? amar leh: in.
Veha ka zayylin pere! amar rav ashe: chazenan; i mechamat tiva zil – menakkenan leh,

a: Vei mechamat tara zil – la menakkenan leh.
Veha ka shavach leinyan nesacha! ella ki ha derav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua avdi ovada bezuze daagardemis tayyaya, ad asara bitmanya.

Amar rabba: hazzorek matbea shel chavero layyam haggadol – patur. may tama? amar: ha mannach kammach, i baet shikleh. vehane mille bitzlulin – deka chaze leh, aval achurin – dela kachaze leh, la. vehane mille deaddeyeh addoye, aval shakleh bideh – migzal gazleh; hashava bae mebad.

Metiv rava: en mechallelin al maot sheenan birshuto. ketzad? hayu lo maot bekastera o behar hammelech, o shennafal kiso layyam haggadol – en mechallelin! amar rabba: shane leinyan maaser, devaenan matzuy beyadcha; derachamana amar: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha", velekka.
Veamar rabba: hashshaf matbea shel chavero – patur. may tama? deha la avad vela midde. vehane mille demachyeh bekurenasa vetarsheh, aval shayyfe beshofina – chassore chassereh.
Metiv rava: hikkahu al eno vesimmeah, al ozno (vechersho) [vechershah] – eved yotze bahen lecherut. keneged eno veeno roe, keneged ozno veeno shome – en eved yotze bahen lecherut.
Rabba letameh, deamar rabba: chersho leaviv – neherag; shei efshar lacharisha belo chabbura, detippeta didma nefalat leh beunneh.
Veamar rabba: hatztzorem ozen parato shel chavero – patur. may tama? para kidkayyma kayyma, dela avad vela midde; vechullehu shevorim lav legabbe mizbeach kayymi.

Metiv rava: haose melacha beme chattat uvefarat chattat – patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim. melacha hu dela minnechar hezzeka; aval tzorem – deminnechar hezzeka, hachi name dimchayyev bedine adam!
Amri: hu haddin daafillu tzorem patur, veha ka mashma lan – daafillu melacha dela minnechar hezzeka, chayyayv bedine shamayim.
Veamar rabba: hassoref shetaro shel chavero – patur. daamar leh: neyayra kelay minnach. matkef la rame bar chama: hechi dame?
b: I deikka sahadi deyadi may hava bishtara, lichtevu leh shetara mealleya! vei delekka sahadi, anan mena yadinan? amar rava: tehe bemaamino.

Amar rav dimi bar chanina: ha derabba – machaloket rabbi shimon verabbanan hi. lerabbi shimon deamar davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame – mechayyev; lerabbanan deamri davar haggorem lemamon lav kemamon dame – la mechayyev.

Matkef la rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: emar deshamat leh lerabbi shimon davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame – bedavar sheikkaro mamon, kidrabba; deamar rabba: gazal chametz lifne happesach, uva acher userafo bammoed – patur, shehakkol metzuvvivym alav levaaro. leachar happesach – machloket rabbi shimon verabbanan;
Lerabbi shimon deamar davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame – chayyayv, lerabbanan deamri davar haggorem lemamon lav kemamon dame – patur. bedavar sheen ikkaro mamon mi amrinan?

Amar ammemar: man dedaen dina degarme – magbe beh deme shetara mealleya, uman dela daen dina degarme – magbe beh deme neyayra bealma. hava ovada vechafyeh rafram lerav ashe, veagbi beh ki keshura letzalma.

Chametz veavar alav happesach – omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha". man tanna omrin beissure hanaa "hare shellecha lefanecha"? amar rav chisda: rabbi yaakov hi. detanya: shor shehemit; ad shello nigmar dino – mecharo machur, hikdisho mukedash, shechato – besaro muttar, hechziro shomer livalav – muchezar.

Mishshennigmar dino – mecharo eno machur, hikdisho eno mukedash, shechato – besaro asur, hechziro shomer livalav – eno muchezar. rabbi yaakov omer: af mishshennigmar dino, hechziro shomer livalav – muchezar.
May, lav beha kamippalgi – derabbi yaakov savar: omrin beissure hanaa "hare shellecha lefanecha", verabbanan savri: en omrin beissure hanaa "hare shellecha lefanecha"?
Amar leh rabba: la, dechulle alma amrinan beissure hanaa "hare shellecha lefanecha"; deim ken, niflegu bechametz bappesach. ella amar rabba: hacha begomrin dino shel shor shello befanav ka mippalgi –

Rabbanan savri: en gomrin dino shel shor shello befanav, daamar leh: i ayytiteh nihalay – hava marekna leh leagma, hasheta mesarteh beyad man dela matzena leishtaoye dina bahadeh! verabbi yaakov savar: gomrin dino shel shor shello befanav, daamar leh: may avadi leh? sof sof hava gamri leh (dina) [ledineh] shello befanav.
Ashkecheh rav chisda lerabba bar shemuel, amar leh: tenet midde beissure hanaa? amar leh: in, tenena: "veheshiv et haggezela"; ma talmud lomar "asher gazal"? yachazir keen sheggazal.

Mikkan amru: gazal matbea venifsal, perot vehirkivu, yayin vehechmitz, teruma venitmet, chametz veavar alav happesach, behema veneevda bah avera, veshor ad shello nigmar dino – omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha".

Man shamat leh deamar: ad shello nigmar dino – in, mishshennigmar dino – la? rabbanan; vekatane: chametz veavar alav happesach – omer lo "hare shellecha lefanecha"! amar leh: i mashkachat lehu, la tema lehu vela midde.
Perot vehirkivu – omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha". vehatnan: perot vehirkivu – meshallem kishat haggezela! amar rav pappa: kan shehirkivu kullan, kan shehirkivu miktzatan.

Mishna natan laummanin letakken, vekilkelu – chayyayvin leshallem. natan lecharash shidda teva umigdal letakken, vekilkel – chayyayv leshallem. vehabbannay shekkibbel alav listor et hakkotel, veshibber haavanim o shehizzikan – chayyayv leshallem. haya soter mitztzad ze venafal mitztzad acher – patur; veim mechamat hammakka – chayyayv.

Gemara amar rav assi: lo shanu ella shennatan lecharash shidda teva umigdal – linotz bahen masmer, venaatz bahen masmer veshibberan; aval natan lecharash etzim laasot shidda teva umigdal, veasa mehen shidda teva umigdal veshibberan – patur.
May tama? umman kone bishvach keli.
Tenan: natan laummanin vekilkelu – chayyayvin leshallem. may, lav deyahev lehu etzim? la, shidda teva umigdal.

Ha middekatane sefa: shidda teva umigdal, mikkelal deresha – etzim! amri: paroshe ka mefaresh la – ketzad natan laummanin letakken vekilkelu chayyayvin leshallem? kegon shennatan lecharash shidda teva umigdal.
Vehachi name mistabbera – dechetzad" katane. dei salka datach resha etzim; hasheta ashmeinan etzim chayyayvin leshallem – vela amrinan umman kone bishvach kelim; shidda teva umigdal mibbaya?

I mishshum ha – la irya. tena sefa legalloye resha, shello tomar: resha shidda teva umigdal – aval etzim la; tena sefa: shidda teva umigdal – mikkelal deresha etzim, vaafillu hachi chayyayv leshallem.
Lema mesayyay leh: hannoten tzemer latzabba,

a: Vehikdicho yora – noten lo deme tzamro. deme tzamro – in, deme tzamro veshivcho – la; lav shehikdicho leachar nefila, deikka shevacha, ushema minna umman kone bishvach keli?
Amar shemuel: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehikdicho bishat nefila, delekka shevacha. aval hikdicho leachar nefila may? noten lo deme tzamro veshivcho?! lema shemuel let leh derav assi?
Amar lach shemuel: hacha bemay askinan – kegon detzemer vesammanin devaal habbayit, vetzabba agar yedeh hu deshakel.
I hachi, "noten lo deme tzamro vesammanin" mibbee leh! ella shemuel dachoye ka medache leh.

Ta shema: hannoten tallito leumman; gemaro vehodio – afillu mikkan vead asara yamim eno over alav mishshum "lo talin". netanah lo bachatzi hayyom – kevan sheshshaka alav hachamma, over alav mishshum "bal talin".
Vei salka datach umman kone bishvach keli, ammay over mishshum "bal talin"?
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana: begirda desarbala, delekka shevacha.
Sof sof, lemay yahava nihaleh – lerakkoche; kevan derakkecheh, hayeynu shevacha! la tzericha, deagreh levitshe – bitsha bitsha bemaata, dehayynu sechirut.
Ulemay dislek addatin meikkara dela agreh levitshe, mesayyay leh lerav sheshet – divo minneh merav sheshet: kabbelanut, over alav mishshum "bal talin", o eno over? vaamar lehu rav sheshet: over.
Lema derav sheshet peliga adderav assi? amar shemuel bar acha: bishlicha deiggarta.
Lema ketannae? "ase li sherim, nezamin vetabbaot, veekkaddesh lach", kevan sheasaan – mekuddeshet, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: enah mekuddeshet ad sheyyaggia mamon leyadah.
May "mamon"? illema oto mamon, mikkelal derabbi meir savar oto mamon la?! ella bemay [ku] mikkaddesha? ella peshita, may "mamon" – mamon acher;
Vesavruha dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof; udechulle alma hamekaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet.
May, lav beumman kone bishvach keli kamippalgi? derabbi meir savar: umman kone bishvach keli, verabbanan savri: en umman kone bishvach keli?
La, dechulle alma en umman kone bishvach keli; ella hacha beyeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof ka mippalgi –
Rabbi meir savar: en lischirut ella levassof, verabbanan savri: yesh lischirut mittechilla vead sof.

Vei baet ema: dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof, vehacha bimkaddesh bemilva kamippalgi – derabbi meir savar: hamekaddesh bemilva – mekuddeshet, verabbanan savri: hamekaddesh bemilva – enah mekuddeshet.
b: Rava amar: dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof, udechulle alma hamekaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet, udechulle alma en umman kone bishvach keli;
Ella hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehosif lah nofech mishshello. rabbi meir savar: milva uferuta – data apperuta, verabbanan savri: milva uferuta – data ammilva.

Uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: "bischar sheasiti immach" – enah mekuddeshet. "bischar sheeese immach" – mekuddeshet. rabbi natan omer: "bischar sheeese immach" – enah mekuddeshet, vechol shekken "bischar sheasiti immach".
Verabbi yehuda hannasi omer, beemet amru: ben "bischar sheasiti immach", uven "bischar sheeese immach" – enah mekuddeshet. veim hosif lah nofech mishshello – mekuddeshet.
May ikka ben tanna kamma lerabbi natan? ikka benayyhu sechirut. ben rabbi natan lerabbi yehuda hannasi? ikka benayyhu milva uferuta.
Amar shemuel: tabbach umman shekkilkel – chayyayv leshallem. mazzik hu, poshea hu, naasa keomer lo: "shechot li mikkan", veshachat lo mikkan.
Lema leh lememar "mazzik hu, poshea hu"? i amar "mazzik hu", hava amena hane mille hecha deka aved besachar, aval hecha deka aved bechinnam – la; ka mashma lan "poshea hu".
Etiveh rav chama bar gureya lishmuel: hannoten behema lattabbach venibbelah, umman – patur, hedyot – chayyayv. veim noten sachar, ben hedyot ben umman – chayyayv! amar leh: liachar mochach!

Ata hahu merabbanan ka motev leh. amar leh: hasheta shaklat may dishkal chavrach! kaamena lechu ana rabbi meir, vekaamritu li rabbanan?! ammay la dayykat mille – sheani omer: mazzik hu, poshea hu, naase keomer lo "shechot li mikkan" – veshachat lo mikkan; man it leh hay sevara – rabbi meir, deamar: mibbee leh lemirme annafsheh!
He rabbi meir? illema [ha] rabbi meir (180 siman) –
Ditnan: kesharo bealav bemosera venaal befanav karauy, veyatza vehizzik, ben tam ben muad – chayyayv, divre rabbi meir.
Hatam bikrae peligi!
Ella ha rabbi meir – ditnan: litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor, shachor utzevao adom – rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme tzamro. hatam beyadayim kelav minneh!

Ella ha rabbi meir – ditnan: nishbera kaddo velo sillekah, nafla gemallo velo heemida – rabbi meir omer: chayyayv benizkan, vachachamim omrim: patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim. vekayyma lan divnitkal poshea hu peligi.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: tabbach umman shekkilkel – chayyayv, vaafillu hu umman ketabbache tzippori. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi?! vehaamar rabba bar bar chana: ovada hava kammeh derabbi yochanan bichnishta demaon, vaamar leh: zil ayyti reaya demamchet letarnegolim, veefterach!
La kashya; kan bechinnam, kan besachar. ki ha deamar rabbi zera: harotze sheyyitchayyev lo tabbach – yakdim lo dinar.

Metivi: hammolich chittim lattachon – velo letatan, vaasaan subbin o muresan; kemach lannachtom – vaasao pat nippulin; behema lattabbach – venibbelah; chayyayv, mippene shehu kenose sachar! ema: mippene shehu nose sachar.
Hahu magrumeta daatay lekammeh derav, tarfe, ufatreh letabbach milleshallome deme. pegau beh rav kahana verav assi behahu gavra, amaru leh: aved bach rav tarte.
May tarte? ilema tarte ligriuta – deibbei leh leachshore kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, vetarfa kerabbanan; vei name kerabbanan – deibbei leh chiyyuva letabbacha; umi shere lememar ki hay gavna?!
Vehatanya: lichsheyyetze, lo yomar: "ani mezakke vachaveray mechayyeyvin, aval ma eese shechaveray rabbu alay", veal ze neemar: "holech rachil megalle sod"!
Ella tarte limalleyuta – dela ochlach sefek issura, umanach missefek gezela.
Ittemar: hammare dinar lashshulechani venimtza ra, tane chada: umman – patur, hedyot – chayyayv; vetanya iddach: ben umman ben hedyot – chayyayv!
Amar rav pappa: ki tanya umman patur – kegon danku veissur, dela tzerichi lemigmar kelal. ella bemay teo? teo besikketa chadta, dehahi shata dinfak mittute sikketa.

Hahi itteta deachzeya dinara lerabbi chiyyay, amar la: mealleya hu. lemachar atay lekammeh, vaamara leh: achaziteh, vaamaru li bisha hu, vela ka nafek li! amar leh lerav: zil challefeh nihala, uchetov appinkasi: "den esek bish".
Umay shena danku veissur diftiri – mishshum dela tzerichi lemigmar? rabbi chiyyay name lav lemigmar ka bae! rabbi chiyyay, lifnim mishshurat haddin hu daavad. kidtane rav yosef: "vehodata lahem" – ze

a: Bet chayyehem. "et hadderech" – zo gemilut chasadim. "yelchu" – zo bikkur cholim. "bah" – zo kevura. "et hammaase" – ze haddin. "asher yaasun" – zo lifnim mishshurat haddin.

Resh lakish achvi leh dinara lerabbi elazar. amar: mealleya hu. amar leh: chazi daalach ka samachyna. amar leh: ki samchat alay may lememra, dei mishtechach bisha – baena leaychlofe lach? veha at hu deamrat: rabbi meir hu, dedaen dina digrame. may, lav rabbi meir – vela sevira lan kevoteh?
Amar leh: la, rabbi meir – usevira lan kevoteh.
He rabbi meir? ilema rabbi meir (4 30 40 80 siman)
Ditnan: dan et haddin; zikka et hachayyayv; chiyyev et hazzakkay; timme et hattahor; tiher et hattame – ma sheasa asuy, vishallem mibbeto.
Ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi ila amar rav: vehu shennatal venatan bayyad!
Ella ha rabbi meir – ditnan: litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor, shachor utzevao adom – rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme tzamro. hatam ka aved beyadayim!
Ella ha rabbi meir – ditnan: hamesakkech gafno al gabbe tevuato shel chavero – hare ze kiddesh, vechayyayv. hatam name ka aved beyadayim!
Ella ha rabbi meir – detanya: mechitzat hakkerem shennifretza –
b: Omer lo "gedor". nifretza – omer lo "gedor", nityayesh mimmenna velo gedarah – hare ze kiddesh, vechayyayv beachrayuto.

Mishna hannoten tzemer latzabba, vehikdicho yora – noten lo deme tzamro. tzevao kaur – im hashshevach yater al hayyetzia, noten lo et hayyetzia; veim hayyetzia yetera al hashshevach, noten lo et hashshevach.

Litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor, shachor utzevao adom – rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme tzamro. rabbi yehuda omer: im hashshevach yater al hayyetzia – noten lo et hayyetzia, veim hayyetzia yetera al hashshevach – noten lo et hashshevach.
Gemara may "kaur"? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar bar chana: kalbos. may kalbos? amar rabba bar shemuel:

a: Kafra dude.

Tanu rabbanan: hannoten etzim lecharash laasot mehen kisse, veasa mehen safsal; safsal, veasa mehen kisse – rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme etzav. rabbi yehuda omer: im hashshevach yater al hayyetzia – noten lo et hayyetzia, veim hayyetzia yetera al hashshevach – noten lo et hashshevach.

Umode rabbi meir im natan etzim lecharash laasot mehen kisse nae, veasa mehen kisse kaur; safsal nae, veasa safsal kaur – im hashshevach yater al hayyetzia, noten lo deme hayyetzia; veim hayyetzia yetera al hashshevach, noten lo deme hashshevach.
Ibbaya lehu: yesh shevach sammanin al hatztzemer, o en shevach sammanin al hatztzemer?
Hechi dame? illema digzal sammanin vedakkinhu uteranhu utzeva (bahen) [behu], tippok leh mishshum diknanhu beshinnuy!

La tzericha, digzal sammanin sheruyin, utzeva behu. may? yesh shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer, daamar leh: "hav li sammanay dishkaltinhu"; o dilma en shevach sammanin al gabbe hatztzemer, daamar leh: "let lacha gabbay vela midde"?
Amri: vei en shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer, mi matze amar leh: "let lacha gabbay vela midde"?! nema leh: "hav li sammanay deafsedtinhu"!

Ella lehach gisa: en shevach sammanin al gabbe hatztzemer, uvae shallome leh; o dilma yesh shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer, vaamar leh: "ha mannechi kammach – shiklinhu"? "shiklinhu"?! bemay (shakleh) [shakel lehu], betzafon? tzafon abbore meyabbar, hashava la aved!

Ella hacha bemay askinan – kegon digzal tzemer vesammanin dechad, vetzaveh lehahu tzemer behanach sammanin, veka mahdar leh nihaleh letzemer. yesh shevach sammanin al gabbe hatztzemer, veka mahdar leh sammanin vetzemer; o dilma en shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer, vetzemer mahdar leh, sammanin la mahdar leh?
Amri: tippok leh deiyyaykkar leh nihaleh bidme! la tzericha, dezal tziva. veibbaet ema: kegon shetztzava behu kofa.

Ravina amar: hacha bemay askinan – kegon detzemer dechad vesammanin dechad, vekaate kof vetzaveh lehahu tzemer behanach sammanin. yesh shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer, daamar leh: hav li sammanay degabbach ninhu; o dilma en shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer, vaamar leh: let lacha gabbay kelum?
Ta shema: beged shetztzevao biklippe orla – yiddalek. alma chazuta milleta hi!
Amar rava: hanaa hannire laenayim asra tora – detanya: "arelim lo yeachel" – en li ella issur achila; minnayin shello yehane mimmennu, velo yitzba [bo], velo yadlik bo et hanner?
Talmud lomar: "vaaraltem orlato et piryo", "arelim lo yeachel" – lerabbot et kullam.
Ta shema: beged shetztzevao biklippe sheviit – yiddalek! shane hatam, deamar kera: "tihye" – bahavayatah tehe.
b: Rava rame, tenan: beged shetztzevao biklippe orla – yiddalek; alma chazuta milleta hi. ureminhi: reviit dam shennivlea babbayit – habbayit tame. veamri la: habbayit tahor. vela peligi, ha bechelim dahavo meikkara, ha bechelim daato levassof.
Nivlea bichsut – roin; im mitkabbeset hakkesut veyotza mimmenna reviit dam – temea, veim lav – tehora!
Amar rav kahana: mikkulle reviiyyot shanu kan; bedam tevusa derabbanan.
Rava rame, tenan: mimmin hatztzovin – sefiche setis vekotza, yesh lahen sheviit velidmehen sheviit, yesh lahen biur velidmehen biur. alma etzim yesh bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit.
Ureminhi: ale kanim vaale gefanim sheggibbevan becheve al pene hassade, likketan laachila – yesh bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit, leetzim – en bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit!
Umeshanne, amar kera: "leochla" – bemi shehanaato uviuro shavin, yatzu etzim shehanaatan achar biuran.
Veha ikka etzim demishchan, dahanaatan uviuran shavin!
Amar rava:

a: Setam etzim – lehassaka hen omdin.
Amar rav kahana: veetzim lehassaka – tannae hi, detanya: en mosrin perot sheviit lo lemishra velo lichvusa. verabbi yose omer: notnin perot sheviit letoch hammishra uletoch hakkevusa.
May tama derabbanan? amar kera: "leochla" – velo lemishra, "leochla" – velo lichvusa. verabbi yose omer, amar kera: "lachem" – lechol tzorchechem.
Verabbanan name, hachtiv "lachem"! "lachem" duvmya dilachla" – bemi shehanaato uviuro shavin, yatzu mishra uchevusa shehanaatan achar biuran.

Verabbi yose name, hachtiv "leochla"! amar lach: hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya. detanya: "leochla" – velo limlugema. atta omer "leochla" velo limlugema; o eno ella "leochla" velo lichvusa? keshehu omer "lachem" – hare kevusa amur; ha ma ani mekayyem "leochla"? "leochla" – velo limlugema.
Uma raita lerabbot hakkevusa ulehotzi et hammelugema? merabbe ani et hakkevusa – sheshshava bechol adam, umotzi ani et hammelugema – sheeno shave bechol adam.
Keman azla ha detanya: "leochla" – velo limlugema, "leochla" – velo lezilluf, "leochla" – velo laasot mimmenna appiktevizin? keman – kerabbi yose; dei kerabbanan, ikka name mishra uchevusa.
Rabbi yehuda omer: im hashshevach kulei. (siman 112)
Yatev rav yosef achore derabbi abba – kammeh derav huna, veyatev rav huna vekaamar: halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha, vahalacha kerabbi yehuda.
Ahderinhu rav yosef leappeh, amar: bishlama rabbi yehoshua ben korcha – itzterich; salka datach amena: yachid verabbim – halacha kerabbim, ka mashma lan halacha keyachid.
Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha may hi? detanya, rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: milva bishtar – en nifrain mehen. milva al pe – nifrain mehen, mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam.
Ella "halacha kerabbi yehuda" lema li? machloket veachar kach setam hi, umachloket veachar kach setam – halacha kistam!

Machaloket – bevava kamma, litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor, shachor utzevao adom – rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme tzamro. rabbi yehuda omer: im hashshevach yater al hayyetzia – noten lo et hayyetzia, veim hayyetzia yetera al hashshevach – noten lo et hashshevach. usetam – bevava metzia, ditnan: kol hameshanne – yado al hattachtona, vechol hachozer bo – yado al hattachtona!

Verav huna – itzterich; salka datach amena: en seder lammishna, usetam veachar kach machloket hi. verav yosef – i hachi, kol machloket veachar kach setama – nema: en seder lammishna, usetam veachar kach machaloket hi!
Verav huna – ki la amrinan en seder lammishna, bachada massechta; aval bitre massechtot amrinan. verav yosef – kulla nezikin chada massechta hi.
Veibbaet ema: mishshum dekatane la gabbe hilchata pesikata – kol hameshanne, yado al hattachtona; vechol hachozer bo, yado al hattachtona.
Tanu rabbanan: hannoten maot lishlucho
b: Likkach lo chittin – velakach mehem seorin, seorin – velakach mehem chittin; tanya chada: im pachatu – pachatu lo, veim hotiru – hotiru lo; vetane chada: im pachatu – pachatu lo, veim hotiru – hotiru laemtza!
Amar rabbi yochanan: la kashya; ha rabbi meir, veha rabbi yehuda.
Ha rabbi meir, deamar shinnuy kone; veha rabbi yehuda, deamar shinnuy eno kone.
Matkef la rabbi elazar: mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir – ella bemidde dachaze leh legufeh, aval lischora – la amar!
Ella amar rabbi elazar: ha veha rabbi meir, vela kashya – kan laachila, kan lischora.

Machachu ala bemareva: lerabbi yochanan allibba derabbi yehuda, vechi mi hodio levaal chittin – sheyyakne chittin levaal maot? matkef la rav shemuel bar sasrati: i hachi, afillu chittin vechittin name la!
Amar rabbi avahu: shane chittin vechittin, dishlichuteh ka aved – vechi baal habbayit dame.
Tidda – ditnan: echad hammakdish nechasav, veechad hammaarich et atzmo – en lo bichsut ishto, velo bichsut banav, velo betzeva shetztzava lishman, velo besandalim chadashim shellekachan lishman.

Veammay? lema hacha name: mi hodio latzabba – sheyyakne tzivo laishsha? ella lav mishshum deamrinan [dishlichuteh ka aved, ucheyad ishto dame? hacha name] shelichuteh ka aved, ucheyad baal habbayit dame.
Amar rabbi abba: lo; kol hammakdish nechasav – en dato al kesut ishto uvanav.

Matkef la rabbi zera: vechi dato shel adam al tefillav? utenan: hammakdish nechasav – maalin lo tefillin! amar leh abbaye: in; dato shel adam al tefillin – hammakdish nechasav savar: mitzva ka avedna. veen dato shel adam al kesut ishto uvanav – mishshum eva.
Matkef la rav oshaya: vahalo chayyayve arachin shanu kan, utenan: chayyayve arachin – memashkenin otan;
Vechi dato shel adam al atzmo lemashkeno?!
Ella amar rabbi abba: kol hammakdish nechasav – naasa kemi shehikna lahen kesut ishto uvanav meikkara.
Tanu rabbanan: hallokeach sade beshem chavero – en kofin oto limkor. veim amar lo: "al menat" – kofin oto limkor.
May kaamar? amar rav sheshet, hachi kaamar: hallokeach sade mechavero beshem resh galuta – en kofin oto resh galuta limkor. veim amar "al menat" – kofin et resh galuta limkor.

Amar mar: hallokeach sade beshem resh galuta – en kofin oto resh galuta limkor. mikkelal demikna kanya leh; lema peliga divne mareva, deamri: vechi mi hodio levaal chittin – sheyyakne chittin levaal habbayit?
I mishshum ha – la kashya; kegon deodeh levaal sade, veodinhu lesahade.
Ella ema sefa: "al menat" – kofin oto resh galuta limkor. ammay? velema resh galuta: la yekarayychu baena, vela zilutayychu baena!
Ella amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: hallokeach sade beshem chavero, resh galuta –
